facilities.name: Skottvång weak bus context
facilities.description: No dependable regular stop was verified at Skottvångs gruva itself. Bus 543/Skottvångsvägen can mean about 3.5 km or 50 minutes of road walking, while complementary traffic is limited, pre-booked, and timetable-dependent.

sections.name: Stage 16: Skottvångs gruva to Harsjöhult
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 16, Skottvångs gruva to Harsjöhult.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Skottvång is a strong but opening-hour-dependent start service node with parking, restaurant/cafe/pub, museum, toilets, shower, sauna, tap water, shelters, and bookable lodging nearby.

Harsjöhult has limited parking/access and the stage junction for stage 17, stage 16:1, and the Gallsjömossen loop. It is not a developed service node. Public transport is weak; the practical transit approach is usually via Åkers Styckebruk and stage 16:1.

Bredsjön is the strongest mid-stage rest/overnight node with shelter, fireplace, dry toilet, lake access, and reported tentable flat/rock areas nearby, but it should not be labeled as a formal or bookable campsite.

Neither endpoint is an easy normal-transit endpoint. Skottvång may require road walk, taxi, or prebooked complementary traffic; Harsjöhult normally means walking the 16:1 connector from Åkers Styckebruk.
waterSources: Skottvång has the only listed tap water, but access is service-dependent rather than guaranteed 24/7.

The three official springs at Lilla Vasskärr, southeast of Bredsjön, and Harsjöhult are natural/untested sources; filter/boil/treat and carry backup. Recent hikers found water at Bredsjön-side and Harsjöhult springs, but Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee flow or quality.
Bredsjön and Älskaren are natural lake water only, useful in an emergency with treatment but not potable refill points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10 km; Naturkartan/Äventyrligare list about 9.8-9.85 km, a 2026 Naturkartan GPX check measured about 9.82 km, and AllTrails-style traces show about 10.1 km with roughly 330 m ascent. OSM relation 3806516 is usable but has stale tags: distance=11 km and fixme=incomplete, while current member geometry measures about 9.87 km and supports the official 10 km.

Naturkartan GPX may be stored Harsjöhult-to-Skottvång even though the official direction is Skottvång to Harsjöhult. For OSM, graph-sort relation 3806516 and orient it from Skottvång node 2906044370 to the Harsjöhult/Stage 17 junction node 2926356244; keep the nearby Harsjöhult spring separate.

Skottvång is a small route hub rather than a single shared node. Stage 15 hands to Stage 16 at node 2906044370, while Stage 15:2 reaches the area through Stage 15/local connector logic and its southern reconnect node 2298697773 sits about 350 m away from the Stage 16 start.

Route character: mining history, forest paths, springs, wet low sections before Bredsjön, Bredsjön shelter, Älskaren, and Gallsjömossen reserve context near Harsjöhult. Reports describe it as moderate/easy, but after rain or in winter it can mean wet feet, icy descents, or slower boardwalk/bog travel.

Official pages for Stages 16, 16:1, and 17 showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. A 2024-04-01 Stage 16 user comment thanked maintainers for warning about a flooded creek, and hiker reports mention wet ground, alternate-sign context before Bredsjön, and boardwalked wetland after Bredsjön; keep this as condition context rather than an active closure.
Heritage highlights include Skottvång mining area, Stora Vasskärr poorhouse/croft remains, an offergryta/giant pothole, Älgsjöbacken mine remains, old railway/slag heaps, and charcoal/cabin traces.

Gallsjömossen reserve rules apply near Harsjöhult: do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs, collect plants/fungi/lichens beyond allowed personal-use exceptions, damage invertebrate habitats, or arrange camps/competitions without permission. No specific public dog, fishing, or tenting ban was found on the reserve page, but local signs and fire bans still apply.

Do not route drivers along private/prohibited roads between Skottvång and Harsjöhult; use marked parking/access points and check local road signs. Hiker reports specifically describe a direct-looking Skottvång-Harsjöhult road approach being blocked/prohibited.

facilities.name: Skottvångs gruva stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start and service/heritage node with restaurant/cafe/pub, museum, parking, toilets, shower/sauna/tap context, and lodging nearby. Opening hours are limited, seasonal, and event-dependent, with food mostly a weekend/service-hours assumption.

facilities.name: Skottvång Stage 15/16 handoff
facilities.description: OSM node 2906044370 is the practical topological handoff from Stage 15 to Stage 16 and should be used when graph-sorting relation 3806516.

facilities.name: Skottvång parking
facilities.description: Start parking; Skottvång also lists a few overnight/RV/caravan spaces without electricity/toilet service and overflow at Roligheten about 500 m away. Check local signs.

facilities.name: Skottvång tap
facilities.description: Official tap water at Skottvång, but access may depend on bybastun/service opening or booked access and should not be treated as all-hours guaranteed.

facilities.name: Skottvång toilets
facilities.description: Toilet and accessible-toilet context in the Skottvång cultural village/service area; access may depend on opening hours, events, or booked facilities.

facilities.name: Skottvång lodging context
facilities.description: Bookable lodging context including Skumbo's 10 bunks plus bybastu/kitchen/water/showers/toilet, and nearby Häxans hus/Lilla Vasskärr/Krampan options. Book and verify access ahead.

facilities.name: Skottvång official stage-16 shelter
facilities.description: Official stage-16 shelter coordinate near Skottvång, distinct from the Stage 15/15:2 shelter coordinate. Sörmlandsleden shelters are shared, free, non-bookable, and have no guaranteed firewood or trash service.

facilities.name: Skottvång mapped shelter/fire roof
facilities.description: Separate mapped shelter/fire-roof near Skottvång listed by shelter/map sources and close to the Stage 15/15:2 shelter coordinate; keep distinct from the official stage-16 shelter and verify local use rules.

facilities.name: Lilla Vasskärr spring
facilities.description: Official spring about 1.5 km from Skottvång. Hiker reports describe good-looking water, but it remains natural/untested and should be treated.

facilities.name: Lilla Vasskärr picnic and B&B sign
facilities.description: Picnic/rest context near the first spring and sign toward nearby Lilla Vasskärr lodging, about 200 m off trail. Private/bookable lodging context only, not a public trail facility; sources list small cabins/cottages and simple facilities.

facilities.name: Fäboda fårbod
facilities.description: Private farm shop/craft/sheepskin context near the early route. Treat as opening-hour dependent, call/check before relying on it, and do not count it as trail resupply.

facilities.name: Stora Vasskärr poorhouse foundation
facilities.description: Approximate signed croft/poorhouse-remains context south of Stora Vasskärr; route-snap before treating as an authoritative archaeology pin.

facilities.name: Offergryta / giant pothole
facilities.description: Approximate notable glacial pothole/offergryta around 4-5 km from Skottvång, mentioned by official text and hiker reports; exact pin remains approximate.

facilities.name: Älgsjöbacken mine area
facilities.description: Approximate historic mine/rest area with 1600s mining remains, info board, old railway embankment, and slag heaps; exact marker should be route-snapped.

facilities.name: Spring southeast of Bredsjön
facilities.description: Official natural spring southeast of Bredsjön. Hiker reports confirm use, but filter/treat and verify flow.

facilities.name: Wet low ground before Bredsjön
facilities.description: Low ground before Bredsjön can be very wet after rain. A 2024-04-01 official-page comment mentions a flooded-creek warning, and hiker reports mention alternate-sign context and slow but passable travel; no current official fault report was found.

facilities.name: Bredsjön shelter
facilities.description: Popular lakeside official shelter and strongest Stage 16 overnight/rest node. Shelter listings indicate about four sleeping places plus benches/fireplace/toilet context; first-come, shared, non-bookable, potentially occupied in season, no guaranteed firewood, and no guaranteed trash service.

facilities.name: Bredsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace at/near the Bredsjön shelter. Use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Bredsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near Bredsjön shelter. Waste bins have been reported by hikers but are not guaranteed; pack out trash.

facilities.name: Bredsjön lake rest and swimming
facilities.description: Natural lake/bathing/rest context by the shelter. Lake water is not potable without treatment.

facilities.name: Bredsjön reported tent spots
facilities.description: Hiker reports describe nearby flat/rocky tentable spots, but this is not a verified bookable campsite. Follow local signs and avoid fragile ground.

facilities.name: Älskaren rest and lake-water context
facilities.description: Approximate scenic rest/fire context near lake Älskaren from official and blog descriptions; lake water requires treatment and ground is reported sloping/stony, so do not present this as a campsite.

facilities.name: Post-Älskaren picnic table
facilities.description: Approximate small-knoll picnic-table context after Älskaren from hiker reports. Useful rest stop, but explicitly not a tent spot until route-snapped and field-verified.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring near the endpoint; 2024 hikers found water but filtered it and noted heavy mosquitoes around the spring. Treat/filter and expect insects/wet ground in season.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult parking
facilities.description: Parking/access for Harsjöhult, Gallsjömossen, stage 16, stage 16:1, and stage 17. Check local road and parking signs.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult information map
facilities.description: Information/map context at the Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen access point.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult stage junction
facilities.description: OSM node 2926356244 is the clean Stage 16-to-Stage 17 junction. Connector 16:1 arrives via the shared final way 1460426509 roughly 40-50 m before this split, matching official connector text.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult tent context
facilities.description: Adjacent official connector text describes Harsjöhult as suitable for tenting with spring nearby; this is not a developed or guaranteed campsite with toilet/shelter, and reserve signs/fire bans still apply.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen reserve warning
facilities.description: Reserve context near Harsjöhult: do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs except wood for a small fire where allowed, collect restricted plants/fungi/lichens beyond berries, edible mushrooms and flowers for personal use, damage invertebrate habitats, or arrange camps/competitions without permission. Fire bans and local signs override the small-fire exception.

facilities.name: Stage 17 continuation caveat
facilities.description: If continuing toward Finnsjön, official Stage 17 warns that an older marked shelter east of Harsjön does not exist and that Finnsjön cannot be reached by car because of a road barrier; Lantmäteriet-based maps may lag current trail routing.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk transit via stage 16:1
facilities.description: Practical public-transport approach to Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen is usually bus 301 from Strängnäs or 306 from Läggesta to Åkers Styckebruk, then about 8 km along stage 16:1.

sections.name: Stage 16:1: Åkers Styckebruk to Harsjöhult
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 16:1, Åkers Styckebruk to Harsjöhult.
utilities: Official area: Strängnäs kommun.

Åkers Styckebruk is the practical transit and service end: bus 301 from Strängnäs and 306 from Läggesta stop near the start, and town services include grocery/restaurant options away from the immediate trail line.
Parking is available behind Folkets hus about 200 m from the official start, at/near the Lenellstorp road crossing, and at Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen.

Harsjöhult is the endpoint junction for stages 16, 16:1, 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop. It has parking, a spring nearby, and official tenting context, but no verified toilet or shelter on 16:1 itself.

Stage 16:1 should stay sparse in the app: nearby shelters, toilets, springs, bathing spots, and firepits around Stage 16/Gallsjömossen/Sandviksbadet are mostly off-route and should not be counted as connector facilities.

Lenellstorp parking is real but coordinate-sensitive: official/Länsstyrelsen sources place a parking pocket with reserve sign where the trail crosses the road, while some OSM-derived pins drift away from the route corridor.
waterSources: The only official water point on the connector is the Harsjöhult spring near the endpoint; treat/filter it as natural water and carry enough from Åkers, especially in summer.
Åkers Styckebruk has town services and an OSM bottle-refill marker near the start, but this was not independently verified as a reliable public trail tap.
Mörtsjön, Göksjön, Flintsjön, and wetland water are natural/untested sources only and should not be presented as planned potable refills. Do not encode asking at summer houses for water as a source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 11 km; Naturkartan lists 10.1 km, a 2026 Naturkartan GPX check measured about 10.13 km to the Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen parking area, Äventyrligare lists about 9.9 km, OSM relation 19988674 is tagged 11 km but measures about 9.94 km, and AllTrails about 11.4-11.6 km with roughly 410 m ascent.

OSM relation 19988674 is geometrically usable but must be graph-oriented from the official Åkers start near node 2871861511 to the Harsjöhult junction node 2926356244. The first OSM member, way 1460424191, is stored opposite the official direction, and naive way-order traversal can create an apparent Åkers gap.

Access connector from Åkers Styckebruk to Harsjöhult: the first 2-3.5 km are mostly small roads, old railway bed, and slaggväg through old industrial/bruk landscape before the route feels properly forested, then Mörtsjön/Mörtsjö ringmur, old croft/fäbod and mining/charcoal traces, Lenellstorpkärret, Flintsjön/Gallsjömossen bog/boardwalk terrain, and the Harsjöhult junction.

Official pages for Stage 16:1, Stage 16, Stage 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass; recent public reviews describe normal seasonal snow, mud, and wet-boardwalk variability rather than an active route closure.

Lenellstorpkärret is a sensitive rich fen/Natura 2000 reserve with orchids and wet ground. Länsstyrelsen says the reserve's short loop currently lacks boardwalk over the fen, while the official connector text says a marked western alternate can be preferable at high water or when boardwalks are icy.

Gallsjömossen reserve rules apply near Harsjöhult: do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs, collect restricted plants/fungi/lichens beyond allowed personal-use exceptions, damage invertebrate habitats, or arrange camps/competitions without permission. Gallsjömossen has a limited small-fire wood exception, but Lenellstorpkärret does not list the same exception; do not promise firewood, and fire bans/local signs override everything.

The official southbound Gallsjömossen alternative after the skvattrammosse and the separate OSM Gallsjömossen roundtrip relation 20102542 are route-builder context, not connector facilities. Attach them near node 8837652896/Harsjöhult and keep them optional rather than stitching them into the 16:1 mainline.

Mörtsjö ringmur is a worthwhile side-trip/viewpoint and heritage point with visible hillfort/ring-wall context and a nearby route-side picnic/view point; present it as optional heritage/rest context, not a core service facility.
Bus 306 can include demand-responsive/taxi-coded departures with limited capacity and advance phone booking; check Sörmlandstrafiken carefully for late, weekend, and Sunday plans.

General dog-control and fishing rules still matter: from 1 March to 20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife can be disturbed, and fishing in the route lakes is not covered by allemansrätten unless a permit/right-holder rule is verified.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk trail start
facilities.description: Official connector start and bus access area. Sörmlandsleden names bus 301 from Strängnäs and 306 from Läggesta; check current departures. Naturkartan's no-stop lookup is not reliable for this start.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk bus stop
facilities.description: Closest mapped bus stop for the start; useful for train-to-Läggesta plus bus 306, or bus 301 from Strängnäs. Nearby Folkets hus stop is around 59.253536,17.097639.

facilities.name: Åkers Folkets hus parking
facilities.description: Parking behind Folkets hus/Mötesplats Åker, about 200 m from the official start. Check local signs before leaving a car.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk bottle refill
facilities.description: OSM-mapped bottle refill near the start, tagged 24/7; useful if working but not independently verified as an official public trail tap.

facilities.name: ICA Åkers Styckebruk
facilities.description: Town grocery/resupply option on Solbergavägen. ICA lists broad daily opening hours and services, but verify current hours before relying on it.

facilities.name: Karas Restaurang & Pizzeria
facilities.description: Restaurant/pizzeria in Åkers Styckebruk, useful before/after the connector but off the immediate trail line; verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Åkers bruksmuseum and old industrial area
facilities.description: Old ironworks/industrial landscape near the early route. Museum in the old grain store and red-vimpel heritage-sign access are seasonal/opening-hour dependent, not dependable daily services.

facilities.name: Mörtsjön scenic lake context
facilities.description: Scenic lake/rest context after the early road/bruk section. Natural lake water only; a 2025 hiker review mentioned barbecue/bathing-rock context near Mörtsjön, but no reliable official bathing/fireplace facility was verified for the connector.

facilities.name: Mörtsjö ringmur rest/view point
facilities.description: Route-side rest/view context below Mörtsjö ringmur. Sörmlandsleden describes the ring-wall hill as a suitable rest place with wide views; treat any picnic/fire details as field-check dependent.

facilities.name: Mörtsjö ringmur side trip
facilities.description: Ancient hillfort/viewpoint side trip near Mörtsjön with an approximately 85 x 65 m enclosure and visible wall remains. It sits just off the connector with signed/path access; show as optional spur/context rather than a core connector facility.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet off-route bathing/fire context
facilities.description: Sandviksbadet/Göksjön is a real bathing place with facilities, but it is about 1.5 km off official 16:1 geometry. Show only as optional detour context, not as an on-route facility.

facilities.name: Hagalund / Åkerby fäboda remains
facilities.description: Approximate old fäbod/croft, former cultivated land, and large-oak landscape context mentioned by official text and hiker reports; route-snap if more exact data appears.

facilities.name: Göksjötorp mining traces
facilities.description: Göksjötorp and nearby old mine-hole/spoil-heap context; official text places mining traces on hills west of the torp. Treat as a safety/heritage area and do not enter pits or disturb remains.

facilities.name: Charcoal and mining traces near Gallsjömossen
facilities.description: Approximate route-near charcoal/mining context corroborated by OSM and reserve/official descriptions. Treat as heritage/safety context and avoid disturbing remains.

facilities.name: Flintsjön natural-water context
facilities.description: Scenic lake near the connector after the high point north of Flintsjön. Natural lake water only; do not present as potable refill.

facilities.name: Lenellstorp / Lenellstorpkärret parking pocket
facilities.description: Official/Länsstyrelsen sources say a parking pocket with reserve sign exists where Sörmlandsleden crosses the road by Lenellstorp/Lenellstorpkärret. Treat as limited roadside/access parking, not a serviced trailhead; OSM-derived pins disagree, so verify signs/safe stopping on arrival.

facilities.name: Lenellstorpkärret wetland warning
facilities.description: Sensitive rich fen/Natura 2000 reserve with orchids and wet ground. Länsstyrelsen says the reserve's short loop currently lacks boardwalk over the fen; use the marked alternate when high water or icy/wet passage makes the main line unsuitable. No firewood exception is listed for this reserve.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen reserve warning
facilities.description: Bog, old-pine forest, boardwalked wet parts, rocky/knobbly ground, old mining landscape, and reserve rules near Harsjöhult. Do not damage vegetation/deadwood or sensitive habitats; berry/edible mushroom/flower picking for own use is allowed where signs permit.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen southern alternative
facilities.description: Route-builder context only: official text describes a southbound alternative after the skvattrammosse through mining ground and periodically wet mires/boardwalks, reconnecting toward stage 16 about 500 m from Harsjöhult.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen loop attachment
facilities.description: Topology marker for optional Gallsjömossen roundtrip relation 20102542. It attaches near the Harsjöhult end via node 8837652896; do not treat the loop as part of the 16:1 mainline by default.

facilities.name: Lavansjö gruvor / Lavansjön mine area
facilities.description: Mapped mine/heritage area near the Gallsjömossen approach and alternative line; about 200 m from the connector geometry and best shown as nearby heritage context.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult information map
facilities.description: Information/map context at the Harsjöhult access point.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult / Gallsjömossen parking
facilities.description: Parking for Gallsjömossen, stage 16, 16:1, and 17; Länsstyrelsen describes the reserve as about 500 m from the parking.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult spring
facilities.description: Official endpoint spring near Harsjöhult, corroborated by OSM. Treat/filter as natural water, and do not assume flow/quality in drought or freezing conditions.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult tent context
facilities.description: Official text says Harsjöhult is suitable for tenting; this is informal, not a formal campsite with toilet/shelter. Keep groups small, avoid blocking trail/parking/private land, and follow reserve signs and fire bans.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult stage junction
facilities.description: Connector endpoint and route-builder junction for stages 16, 16:1, 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop. 16:1 joins the main Sörmlandsleden about 40 m before the stage 16/17 split.

sections.name: Stage 17: Harsjöhult to Finnsjön
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 17, Harsjöhult to Finnsjön.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Harsjöhult has limited parking/access at the public-road end and connects to stages 16, 16:1, 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop; do not treat it as a service node.

Finnsjön is the real overnight node with shelter, fireplace/grill context, dry toilet, trash-bin context, lake access, swimming, and tenting on the shelter point, but several amenities are separated around the point rather than all beside the shelter.

Finnsjön should not be treated as a normal pickup/dropoff point: official Sörmlandsleden warns that the Kalkbro-Finnsjön forest road is gated/blocked to motor traffic and that the barrier may be missing from some Lantmäteriet-based maps. The closest OSM gate context belongs to Stage 18 access and should be shown as a car-access warning, not as a Stage 17 facility.
No bus or train stop is within 2 km of Stage 17 itself; practical public-transport access is via Åkers Styckebruk and the Stage 16:1 connector.
waterSources: No potable tap was verified on stage 17. The best nearby refill is the Harsjöhult cold spring about 50-60 m from the start on the stage-16/16:1 side; treat/filter it as natural water and do not assume tested quality.
Trullsjön and Finnsjön are natural lake water only. Trullsjön is described as brown-water; Finnsjön may look clear but should still be treated.
AllTrails-style 'water' at Finnsjön should be interpreted as lake access, not a potable tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan/OSM also present it as 6 km, Naturkartan GPX and OSM relation 3870287 measure about 5.859 km, Äventyrligare lists 5.84 km, Gaia about 5.95 km, and AllTrails about 6.3 km with about 217 m ascent and a 1.5-2 hour moving-time estimate.

Short but remote forest/myr stage with sparse pine forest, rock slabs, old pasture/woodland, Abborrsjön/Abborrmossen views, Trullsjön, Korsmossen/Pansarmossen/Långmossen, charcoal remains, about 600 m of boardwalks, and final lakeside walking along Finnsjön. After the first roughly 150 m from Harsjöhult there are no normal service buildings or roads until Finnsjön context.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Recent 2025 official comments say fallen trees were cleared by mid-May and the route was well maintained and easy to follow by late September.

OSM relation 3870287 and Naturkartan GPX match closely and are usable, but route rendering should graph-orient from Harsjöhult node 2926356244 to Finnsjön information-map node 2949013106. Way 291430575 and way 291430579 are stored opposite the useful Harsjöhult-to-Finnsjön direction.

Expect roughly 600 m of boardwalks/spångar around Trullsjön, Korsmossen, Pansarmossen, Långmossen, and the Finnsjön shore; wet, icy, spring high-water, and remaining April ice can make boardwalks, beam bridges, and drainage-stream crossings slippery or awkward. Stay on trail and boardwalks through mires to protect vegetation.

Official suitable tent options are Trullsjön, the kolbotten about 100 m north of Långmossen, and the point by Finnsjön shelter. Finnsjön point has the strongest hiker-confirmed tent confidence, Trullsjön is good but can be stony, and the Långmossen kolbotten is official but lacks recent tent-comfort reports. Harsjöhult tenting belongs to adjacent 16:1 context rather than Stage 17's official tent-place list.
Do not add the old Lantmäteriet-map shelter east of Harsjön; Sörmlandsleden explicitly warns that it does not exist.

No source confirmed supplied firewood at Finnsjön. Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance says shelters have fireplace/grill context, but use should be treated as shared first-come shelter use without guaranteed firewood, and fire bans/local signs override any fireplace context.
A 2024 overnight report described rodent/gnawing damage at Finnsjön shelter; store food and scented items securely rather than leaving them in open shelter gear.

General Swedish dog rules still matter here: from 1 March to 20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife can be disturbed, and leash control is usually the practical default on narrow trails and in reserve context.
Fishing is not included in allemansrätten; do not present fishing in Trullsjön or Finnsjön as allowed unless a permit/right-holder rule is verified.

Exclude false-positive facility imports: Grillplatser/Finnsjön Vindskydd results found in Mölndal are not this Stage 17 Finnsjön, and off-route Magsjöberget/Porsudden context belongs mostly to Stage 18 access rather than this stage.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult parking and stage junction
facilities.description: Limited parking/access by public road for stage 17, stage 16, stage 16:1, and Gallsjömossen. Länsstyrelsen describes it as Gallsjömossen reserve parking about 500 m from the reserve; check local signs. After roughly 150 m, the stage becomes remote forest/wetland with no normal services until Finnsjön context.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult information map
facilities.description: Information/map context at the Harsjöhult access point.

facilities.name: Nearby Harsjöhult spring
facilities.description: Nearby cold spring, technically on the stage-16/16:1 side about 50-60 m from the stage-17 start. Treat/filter and do not assume tested quality.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult tent context
facilities.description: Adjacent connector text describes Harsjöhult as suitable for tenting; useful before or after stage 17, but not one of the official Stage 17 tent places. Follow local signs and fire bans.

facilities.name: Berget north of Abborrsjön viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate route-derived viewpoint/rest area on the hill north of Abborrsjön with views over Abborrsjön and Abborrmossen, about 1 km from Harsjöhult.

facilities.name: Finntäppan side-trail junction
facilities.description: Approximate sign/spur-junction context for the old Finn settlement/croft traces; official text describes a 200 m side path, but the exact destination pin is unverified.

facilities.name: Trullsjön rest and lake access
facilities.description: Rest/lunch context by brown-water Trullsjön. Official text lists a small bathing jetty; older reports said ice had damaged it, later Sörmlandsleden newsletter material reported repair with a simple ladder/cleared bottom, and a 2024 hiker report describes a picnic table, simple jetty, and fire ring. Treat any fire ring as local context rather than a verified official fireplace marker. Lake water only.

facilities.name: Trullsjön tent area
facilities.description: Officially listed suitable tent place by Trullsjön. Hiker reports describe it as pleasant but sometimes stony for tents; follow local signs and use low-impact camping.

facilities.name: Trullsjön natural water
facilities.description: Brown-water lake source only; filter/boil/treat and avoid washing/toilet needs near the shore.

facilities.name: Korsmossen / Pansarmossen boardwalks
facilities.description: Approximate long boardwalk/wetland zone, part of the stage's roughly 600 m of spång. Boardwalks and beam bridges can be slippery or icy, and mire drainage can be high after rain or spring melt; stay on the built path to protect mire vegetation.

facilities.name: Kolbotten north of Långmossen
facilities.description: Approximate official tent option at a charcoal base about 100 m north of Långmossen; model as low-impact heritage/tent context rather than a managed campsite, and improve the pin if better field data appears.

facilities.name: Kolarkoja remains
facilities.description: Approximate unusually well-preserved charcoal hut remains with burnt fireplace stones. Treat as protected heritage and do not disturb.

facilities.name: Finnsjön east wet crossings
facilities.description: Approximate drainage-creek zone from the bogs east of Finnsjön; spring melt and rain can make crossings high or wet.

facilities.name: Finnsjön shelter
facilities.description: Shelter at the stage 17/18 boundary, confirmed by shelter/map sources. Shared, first-come, and no guaranteed firewood. Official comments and 2024 reports describe the shelter/toilet as well kept, but one 2024 overnight report mentioned rodents/gnawing, so secure food and scented items.

facilities.name: Finnsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at the Finnsjön shelter based on Sörmlandsleden general shelter guidance and hiker reports. Use only when current fire rules allow and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Finnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near Finnsjön, but not right beside the shelter; official text confirms a toilet at the endpoint and hiker reports describe it as a bit away from the shelter.

facilities.name: Finnsjön trash-bin context
facilities.description: Stage-specific official text and OSM indicate bins/waste context near Finnsjön, but verify in the field and be prepared to pack out trash.

facilities.name: Finnsjön information map
facilities.description: Information/map and shared Stage 17/18 junction context by Finnsjön. Use this as the snapped stage boundary even if GPX linework ends a few metres away.

facilities.name: Finnsjön shelter point tent area
facilities.description: Officially suitable tent place on the point by the shelter. Hiker reports describe many flat spots; keep tents on durable ground and respect shared shelter users.

facilities.name: Finnsjön swimming and lake water
facilities.description: Swimming/lake access near the shelter, with best swimming described on the stage-18 side. This is not a staffed bathing site; use conservative cold-water/open-water judgment. Natural lake water only.

facilities.name: Dog-control season reminder
facilities.description: General Swedish rule context: from 1 March to 20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife can be disturbed. Use leash/control on the narrow trail, wetland boardwalks, and reserve-adjacent sections.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Finnsjön and Trullsjön are lake-water/access context only. Fishing is not part of allemansrätten; verify permits and local rights before fishing.

facilities.name: Finnsjön road barrier warning
facilities.description: Access warning, not an on-route Stage 17 facility: official Sörmlandsleden says Finnsjön cannot be reached by car and warns that the Kalkbro/Finnsjön barrier may be missing from Lantmäteriet-based maps. OSM node 834675266 is a relevant Stage 18 gate/barrier context about 1.7 km from Finnsjön; do not advise bypassing barriers or driving closed/private roads.

sections.name: Stage 18: Finnsjön to Ånhammar
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 18, Finnsjön to Ånhammar.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.

Finnsjön is an overnight/service node at the stage 17/18 boundary, but the official stage start has no public transport and no parking. Car pickup/dropoff is awkward because of the road barrier context from stage 17 and the tiny 2-3 car Körartorpsvägen pull-off before the barrier.

Ånhammar has official parking behind the wagon sheds; the stage board itself is not the parking point. Brotorp about 1.5 km into Stage 19 is a useful alternate parking/rest access if Ånhammar logistics are awkward.

Public transport is poor at both ends. Nearby bus stops such as Ånhammarsvägen, Byringe, and Dunker kyrka are several kilometres away and should be treated as weak access context rather than convenient trailheads.

Rocklösa gård is an off-route, pre-booked lodging/service option about 4-5 km from Ånhammar with cabins, kitchen, shower, toilet, hiking packages, and possible transfer/pickup arrangements; show it as lodging/logistics rather than trail food.
waterSources: No reliable official potable tap or mapped spring was verified on stage 18. Sörmlandsleden may show a generic water facility icon for the shelter areas, but the text does not identify a potable drinking-water source. An OSM seasonal tap near Ånhammar exists, but treat it as field-check backup only.
Finnsjön, Axsjön, Härbärgssjön, Älgsjön, and Kvarnsjön are natural lake water only; filter/boil/treat and avoid presenting lake access as potable water.
A hiker blog reported finding good water on this day, but without a reliable coordinate; do not add it as a water-source marker yet.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 11 km; Naturkartan lists 10.8 km, a Naturkartan GPX check measured about 10.77 km, local official-GPX-derived linework about 10.36 km, Äventyrligare about 10.75 km, AllTrails about 10.5-10.6 km, and OSM relation 1738986 is topologically correct but has stale distance=12 km while measured member geometry is about 10.769 km.

Route character: mostly production forest and clear-cuts with remote-feeling lake passages, steeper hills in places, Magsjöberget edge, Axsjön, Putbergen old-growth reserve, Härbärgssjön shelter, Gustavsbergsgruvorna, Rotsätter/Bottallen, Älgsjön, Kvarnsjön/Dammstugan, and road walking into Ånhammar.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. 2025 comments say fallen trees had been cut, markings and boardwalks were good, the stage was well maintained, and a 2026 AllTrails review also reported very good conditions.

A November 2025 maintainer comment says the trail can be quite wet outside summer and recommends boots. A May 2025 local article described about 300 m of boardwalk work near the Ånhammar direction where old boards were often under water at high flows. Older 2024 overgrowth/fallen-tree reports are likely partly superseded by 2025 clearing notes, but remain useful history for shoulder-season expectations.

Naturkartan Stage 18 GPX and OSM relation 1738986 can be stored Ånhammar-to-Finnsjön even though the official walking direction is Finnsjön-to-Ånhammar; reverse imported geometry if needed. The official-direction OSM member sequence is 291430587, 292086886, 292086894, 292086887, 292086888, 128869450, 292086889, 292086883, 946023062, 69813553, 69787142, 128869451, 128436010; the short Ånhammar connector is legitimate, not a false spur.

Putbergen reserve is stricter than ordinary allemansrätten: no tenting, no fires, no motor vehicles, dogs/pets leashed, no damage to living or dead wood, no disturbance within 100 m of raptor nests, and only limited berry/edible-mushroom collection.
Axsjön is a good rest/view area, but the shelter by Axsjön is private. Do not show it as a public shelter or overnight option.

The strongest overnight nodes are Finnsjön at the start and Härbärgssjön mid-stage. Tenting is explicitly possible northeast of Härbärgssjön shelter by the bathing rock on the island/peninsula, outside Putbergen's no-camping/no-fire rule zone.

Magsjöberget and Putbergen rules differ: Magsjöberget is reserve-edge context with vegetation/deadwood restrictions, old mine/quarry traces, bark-beetle dead-spruce caution, and a limited dead-branch small-fire exception subject to bans/signs, while Putbergen explicitly bans tenting and fires.

Fishing should not be presented as automatically allowed in Finnsjön, Magsjön/Östra Magsjön, Axsjön, Härbärgssjön, Älgsjön, or Kvarnsjön; smaller inland waters generally need a fishing card or landowner/fishing-right permission unless a specific free-fishing rule is verified.
Do not promise trash service on Stage 18 generally. Finnsjön has stage-specific bin/waste context from Stage 17/OSM, but Sörmlandsleden's general guidance is to carry all trash out.

facilities.name: Finnsjön stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start coordinate at the stage 17/18 boundary. No parking or public transport at the start.

facilities.name: Finnsjön shelter
facilities.description: Stage 17/18 boundary shelter with fireplace/grill context, nearby dry toilet, tentable point, and lake access. Shared, first-come, no guaranteed firewood, and secure food/scented items because 2024 overnight reports mention rodents.

facilities.name: Finnsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at Finnsjön shelter. Fire bans override and firewood is not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Finnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Mapped/confirmed dry toilet near Finnsjön shelter; official context confirms toilet at the boundary.

facilities.name: Finnsjön tent and lake-water context
facilities.description: Tentable shelter-point context and natural lake water only. Filter/boil/treat any lake water.

facilities.name: Finnsjön / Körartorpsvägen barrier warning
facilities.description: Access warning: Finnsjön is not a normal car pickup/dropoff point because the Kalkbro/Finnsjön forest-road access is gated or blocked to motor traffic, and the barrier may be missing from some map bases. OSM node 834675266 is a Stage 18 gate with foot/bicycle allowed and motor_vehicle=private; official text says only 2-3 cars can stand before the barrier on Körartorpsvägen.

facilities.name: Magsjöberget / Finnsjön view
facilities.description: OSM peak/view context as the route follows Finnsjön toward Magsjöberget and brushes the reserve edge.

facilities.name: Magsjöberget reserve edge
facilities.description: Reserve-edge/corridor context where stage 18 brushes the southern part of Magsjöberget: hilly/blocky forest, mining/charcoal traces, vegetation/deadwood restrictions, and bark-beetle dead-spruce caution. Not the same no-fire/no-camping rule set as Putbergen; follow local signs and fire bans.

facilities.name: Körartorpsvägen tiny barrier pull-off
facilities.description: Approximate access/pull-off context before the private motor-vehicle barrier on Körartorpsvägen; official text says only 2-3 cars can stand before the boom. Exact parking point is not mapped in OSM, so treat this as approximate and do not block the road.

facilities.name: Axsjön rest/viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate rest/view area by Axsjön where official text describes a good rock/viewpoint on the east side. Natural lake water only; official text warns that the shelter by the lake is private.

facilities.name: Axsjön private shelter warning
facilities.description: OSM maps a shelter here, and older hiker reports suggest damage/burnt remains, but official Sörmlandsleden text explicitly says the Axsjön shelter is private. Do not use as a public shelter.

facilities.name: Putbergen nature reserve rules
facilities.description: Old-growth reserve crossed by the stage's eastern corridor, described by Länsstyrelsen as Sörmland's oldest old-growth forest with very old pines, deadwood, fungi, and storm-felled trunks. No camping, no fires, no motor vehicles, dogs/pets leashed, no damage to living/dead standing or fallen wood, no picking plants except berries, no collecting lichens/fungi except edible mushrooms, and do not disturb wildlife including staying within 100 m of raptor nests.

facilities.name: Putbergen south dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the forest-road crossing near Putbergen's southern boundary, not a Länsstyrelsen reserve-service guarantee. OSM and hiker reports place it before Härbärgssjön.

facilities.name: Härbärgssjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 5.5 km and the primary mid-stage overnight/rest node. Shelter sources list about 4 sleeping places; shared, first-come, no guaranteed firewood. Hiker reports used it for lunch and fire, including in mosquito/rain conditions.

facilities.name: Härbärgssjön fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped firepit/grill beside the shelter, corroborated by shelter/fireplace sources. This is outside Putbergen's no-fire rule context, but use only when fire bans and local rules allow and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Härbärgssjön swim/tent point
facilities.description: Approximate island/peninsula northeast of the shelter where official text says there is a bathing rock and tenting is possible. 2024 hikers described quiet overnighting but stony water edges and brown/humic lake water; avoid fragile shore/reed points and dead-tree hazards. Exact tent/badklippa point still needs field mapping.

facilities.name: Gustavsbergsgruvorna mine shafts
facilities.description: Old mine/heritage cluster after Härbärgssjön; OSM maps several mine-shaft nodes nearby, including points around 59.17358,16.91642 and 59.17389,16.91851. Treat mine holes and remains as safety hazards and protected heritage; do not wander to shaft edges.

facilities.name: Bottallen at Rotsätter
facilities.description: Folk-healing pine/root-opening and former tenant-farm context described by official text and hiker blogs.

facilities.name: Älgsjön rest and natural-water context
facilities.description: Lake/rest context where the stage follows the west side for a few hundred metres. Natural lake water only; not a potable refill.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön boardwalk
facilities.description: Approximate boardwalk/bay crossing before Dammstugan. A 2025 local article described boardwalk rebuilding toward Ånhammar where old boards were often under water at high flows; wet/off-season conditions can still make boards slippery.

facilities.name: Dammstugan mill
facilities.description: Preserved mill/dam context before Ånhammar; local heritage source says older mill equipment remains in the mill house. Information-board context is nearby around 59.151666,16.917025.

facilities.name: Ånhammar possible seasonal tap
facilities.description: OSM-only seasonal drinking-water tap near Ånhammar. Treat as a field-check backup, not a reliable planned refill.

facilities.name: Ånhammar parking
facilities.description: Official parking/access context behind the wagon sheds/vagnslidren. Do not park at the stage board; follow local signs. Local endpoint linework ends within metres of this coordinate, but exact signed parking entrance still needs field confirmation.

facilities.name: Brotorp alternate parking/rest access
facilities.description: Useful access context about 1.5 km into Stage 19 when Ånhammar logistics are awkward. Officially a good parking/rest area on Stage 19, not a Stage 18 endpoint.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Stage lakes are water/access context only. Fishing is not automatically included in allemansrätten; verify permits and local rights before fishing.

facilities.name: Ånhammarsvägen weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant access context only: mapped bus-stop pair north of the stage, several kilometres from Finnsjön and much farther from Ånhammar. Do not present as convenient endpoint transit.

facilities.name: Byringe weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant access context only: Länsstyrelsen names Byringe for Magsjöberget access, about 4 km from the reserve, not as a clean Stage 18 endpoint.

facilities.name: Rocklösa gård lodging context
facilities.description: Off-route, paid/pre-booked lodging and hiking-package logistics option about 4-5 km from Ånhammar/stages 18-19 with cabins, kitchen, shower, toilet, and possible transfer/pickup. Verify booking and season before relying on it.

sections.name: Stage 19: Ånhammar to Henaredalen
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 19, Ånhammar to Henaredalen.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun, Gnesta kommun.
Ånhammar has official parking behind the wagon sheds, not at the stage board. Brotorp about 1.5 km in is the better signed parking/rest access on the stage.

The start passes grazing land at Ånhammar and the first marker/early markings can be easy to miss in or near the open pasture; use the signed road alternative if animals, dogs, wet gates, or field conditions make the pasture uncomfortable.
Ösjön is the main mid-stage rest/overnight area with shelter, fireplace/grill context, toilet, tenting/lake-water context, and high use. Expect it can be occupied on good weekends.

Västersjön shelter sits just beyond the stage-19 end/stage-20 start area and is the strongest end-of-day overnight node, with toilet, fireplace/grill, tent space, lake access, and unknown-quality water.
Henaredalen reserve rules are stricter than normal allemansrätten: no tenting or fires inside the reserve, pets must be leashed/controlled, and dead spruce after bark-beetle damage can fall in wind.
waterSources: The pump well just after the road crossing is useful but not foolproof: Sörmlandsleden says it may need priming with a little water before it takes. Treat it as an availability point, not tested drinking water.
The Henaredalen cold spring about 400 m before the stage end is the best official refill, but it is still a natural source without a quality guarantee; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.
Ösjön and Västersjön are lake water only. Recent hikers filtered yellow/brown lake water successfully, but the app should never label it potable.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 12 km; Naturkartan lists 12.0 km, local official-GPX-derived geometry is about 11.37 km, AllTrails about 12.1 km, OSM relation 1734723 is topologically connected but has stale distance=13 km and computes around 11.83 km, Äventyrligare lists 11.33 km, and a longer Wikiloc trace likely includes access/detour/noise. Use 12 km as the planning figure.

Route character: Ånhammar pasture and Dunkern views, a 260 m boardwalk over wetland, one of Sörmland's notable oak pastures, Kammarstenen side marker, pump well, Ösjön shelter/viewpoint, Bågberget/Horsbetslet/Stenbryggan natural stone bridge, forest ridges, Övre Horsbetslen, Henaredalen spring, and Västersjön shelter just over the stage boundary.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. 2024 comments mention unclear marking at the very beginning and several boardwalks in poor condition, worst after Övre Horsbetslen; a 2025 blog describes the early wetland boardwalks as newly renovated and later marking as usable, and an April 2026 AllTrails report says conditions were great but still muddy.

Use the local shared GPX vertices as topology nodes for route-building: Stage 18/19 meet at Ånhammar around 59.145903,16.910988 and Stage 19/20 meet at Henaredalen around 59.120929,16.799645. OSM relation 1734723 uses start node 1422895783 and end node 2418258366, both within normal tolerance of official endpoints; treat nearby official/OSM endpoint coordinates as aliases within roughly 35 m, not separate trailheads.

If using OSM relation 1734723, keep official spelling Henaredalen even though OSM tags say Henardalen, and assemble by shared endpoints because ways 985411746, 128436773, 128436775, and 128436770 need reverse traversal. Brotorp, Kammarstenen, Stenbryggan, Solbacka access, Ösjön shelter, the spring, and Västersjön shelter are POIs/connectors, not section endpoints or route members.
Ösjön is repeatedly described as popular. Traneving skipped it because there were people around the lake, while a 2025 blog used it for lunch and filtered lake water.

Västersjön shelter is listed by shelter sources as sleeping about six, with toilet behind the shelter, fire ring away from the shelter, steel grill in front, tent space, swimming, and water of unknown quality. Länsstyrelsen places the shelter/fireplace just outside the reserve, so do not generalize this to camping or fires inside Henaredalen reserve; there is no trash or firewood guarantee.
Public transport is weak. Treat Ånhammar/Henaredalen as car/taxi or through-hike logistics; Dunker kyrka and Mortorp are only distant fallback bus contexts and current service must be checked live.
Skansberget/fornborg alternate and the worst fallen-tree/navigation caveats around that loop belong to Stage 20 context, not Stage 19 mainline. Do not attach that optional loop to Stage 19.

Do not mark fishing as allowed in Ösjön, Västersjön, Henaren, or small stage lakes without checking local fishing rights/fishing-card rules; Visit Flen's free-fishing examples found in research did not include these lakes.

facilities.name: Ånhammar parking behind wagon sheds
facilities.description: Official start/access coordinate. Park behind the wagon sheds, not at the stage board; follow local signs.

facilities.name: Ånhammar grazing pasture / road alternative
facilities.description: The stage starts through grazing land where animals may be present and first markings have been reported easy to miss in/open near the pasture. Use the road alternative if needed, especially with dogs, calves, wet gates, nervous hikers, or unclear animal behavior.

facilities.name: Ånhammar wetland boardwalk
facilities.description: One of the trail's longer boardwalks, about 260 m, starts near the Dunkern wetland. A 2025 hiker report described these early boards as newly renovated, but rain/ice can still make them slippery or awkward.

facilities.name: Brotorp parking and rest access
facilities.description: Good parking/rest point south of Ånhammar about 1.5 km into stage 19. Approximate OSM Brotorp-area pin; no clean parking object was verified, so check local signs.

facilities.name: Kammarstenen
facilities.description: Large glacial erratic about 300 m from the trail along the road toward Ånhammar; easiest from Brotorpskorset where it is signed. Geocaching notes mention a picnic table at the Brotorp/Kammarsten parking context, but verify current condition. Pin uses the more precise OSM stone coordinate close to the official DMS.

facilities.name: Pump well after road crossing
facilities.description: Pump well/spring context shortly after the road crossing. Official note says to prime the pump with a little water if it will not take; treat as untested, field-check function/seasonality, filter/boil if needed, and carry backup.

facilities.name: Ösjön viewpoint/rest rock
facilities.description: Mapped viewpoint/rest area above Ösjön used by hikers for lunch with a view over the shelter/lake.

facilities.name: Ösjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 4 km; one of the stage's most popular rest/overnight places. Shared, free, first-come, non-bookable, and can be occupied. Shelter sources mark water quality as unknown; no trash or firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Ösjön fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Shelter fire/grill context based on Sörmlandsleden general shelter guidance. Use only when current fire rules allow and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Ösjön dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM maps a dry toilet just south of the shelter area, matching recent hiker reports. Verify condition on site.

facilities.name: Ösjön tent and natural-water context
facilities.description: Traneving reports good camp spots around Ösjön, but this is a popular shared area. Lake water only; a 2025 hiker filtered very yellow water successfully, but filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Bågberget / Horsbetslet / Stenbryggan
facilities.description: Mapped geology/info-board context for the roughly 10 m natural stone bridge between rock outcrops, a key stage-19 geology highlight. OSM also has a Stenbryggan node nearby; keep as POI context rather than a route member.

facilities.name: Övre Horsbetslen boardwalk warning
facilities.description: 2024 official-page and user reports mention several poor/broken or flooded boardwalks, worst after Övre Horsbetslen. A 2026 report says overall conditions were great but muddy, so keep this as a section-specific wet/footing caution until rechecked.

facilities.name: Henaredalen cold spring
facilities.description: Official cold spring about 400 m before the stage end; recent hikers used it to refill. Treat/filter as a natural source with no water-quality guarantee.

facilities.name: Henaredalen stage boundary
facilities.description: Stage-19 end and stage-20 start area near Västersjön/Henaredalen. Public transport is weak; plan car/taxi/through-hike logistics.

facilities.name: Västersjön shelter
facilities.description: Substantial shelter just beyond the stage boundary with Västersjön view; shelter source lists about 6 sleeping spots and reports it holds tight in heavy rain. Older reports said it had seen better days, while a 2025 hiker found it usable and empty. Shared, non-bookable, and no trash/firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Västersjön fire ring and grill
facilities.description: Fire ring a short distance from the shelter plus steel grill in front. Use only when fire rules allow; the shelter/fireplace context is just outside Henaredalen reserve and does not imply permission inside the reserve.

facilities.name: Västersjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet behind the Västersjön shelter, confirmed by shelter source, OSM, and hiker reports.

facilities.name: Västersjön tent, swim, and lake-water context
facilities.description: Shelter source lists tent space, swimming, drinking water/water of unknown quality. Treat lake/source water and do not tent or make fires inside Henaredalen reserve.

facilities.name: Henaredalen reserve rule boundary
facilities.description: Reserve access context: Länsstyrelsen forbids tenting, fires, motor vehicles, loose pets, flower picking/digging, damaging trees or bushes, littering, and disturbing/capturing/killing wildlife or damaging eggs/nests inside Henaredalen reserve. Västersjön shelter/fireplace is just outside the reserve.

facilities.name: Henaredalen dead-spruce warning
facilities.description: Henaredalen has spruce-bark-beetle damage; dead or damaged spruce can fall more easily, especially in hard wind or heavy rain. Avoid lingering under dead trees.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Ösjön, Västersjön, Henaren, and nearby small lakes are water/access context only. Fishing is not automatically included in allemansrätten; verify local fishing rights or fishing-card requirements first.

facilities.name: Dunker kyrka weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant fallback bus context only, roughly 5-6 km from Ånhammar depending on route. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken service before planning around it.

facilities.name: Mortorp weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant fallback bus context for Henaredalen, roughly 2-3 km away with sparse rural service. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Ånhammar taxi/logistics caveat
facilities.description: Public transport is poor. A 2025 hiker account could not rely on pre-booked ride-app pickup to Ånhammar; arrange taxi/car logistics with margin.

sections.name: Stage 20: Henaredalen to Malmköping
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 20, Henaredalen to Malmköping.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun, Malmköping.
Västersjön shelter, toilet, fireplace/grill, tent space, swimming, and unknown-quality lake water sit at the stage-20 start/stage-19 boundary.

The reserve parking cannot currently be reached by car; use the road barrier shortly after Lisätter instead. OSM maps the lift gate around 59.1341325,16.7560548 and access from there is roughly 0.7 km to the stage mainline, but local signage should decide.

Malmköping is the service end: camping, bathing, toilets/showers, water refill, food, grocery, hotel/lodging, grill place, and bus access are the practical facilities. Camping-area services are on/near the trail; most town services are about 0.6-1 km away.
No regular train serves Malmköping. Use Malmköping busstation for public transport; Museispårvägen/Malmakvarn tram stops are seasonal heritage tram stops, not commute rail.
waterSources: No reliable natural drinking-water source was verified between Västersjön and Malmköping. Carry water or treat lake water in an emergency.
Västersjön/Mörtsjön are natural lake water only. Mörtsjön is a view/rest context, not a verified refill.

Malmköpings camping has the strongest endpoint water refill according to Sörmlandsleden/Visit Flen and mapped service data, but treat it as a facility with seasonal/opening-hour risk rather than a guaranteed always-on tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan, Visit Flen, AllTrails, and OSM also list 6.0 km, Naturkartan's current backing geometry is about 5.91 km, OSM relation 5447840 computes about 6.004 km, Äventyrligare lists 5.89 km, and local official-GPX-derived route geometry is about 5.79 km. Use 6 km as canonical.

Route character: starts at Västersjön/Henaredalen, passes through Henaredalen reserve, optional Skansberget fornborg/viewpoint branch above Henaren, Helvetets port, Mörtsjön, the Staven boundary cairn, varied conifer forest/bedrock and late-stage deciduous forest before Malmköping camping.

Henaredalen reserve rules are stricter than normal allemansrätten: no tenting, no fires, dogs/pets leashed year-round, no damaging trees/bushes, no picking flowers, no disturbing wildlife, no motor vehicles, and no littering.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but 2025 comments warn of fallen trees, missed turns, and difficult navigation on the optional Skansberget/fornborg loop. The stage maintainer says the small loop was re-marked in summer 2025 after bark-beetle/fallen-tree damage, but remains hard going; later 2025 comments describe the alternate as heavily blocked and potentially not passable.

The main route is generally short and service-friendly, but June 2025 comments still mention two difficult fallen-tree passages on the main direction toward Malmköping, and Vardagstur found grass/wetness after rain plus wet shoes/legs near Mörtsjön. Watch splits and old tracks where the trail changes direction.

Use the local shared GPX vertices as topology nodes for route-building: Stage 19/20 meet near 59.120929,16.799645 and Stage 20/21 meet near 59.139907,16.731912. OSM relation 5447840 shares Stage 19 at node 2418258366 near 59.1207390,16.8000930 and Stage 21 at node 3701770339 near 59.1392798,16.7318007; the official Malmköping coordinate is about 48 m away, so treat these as aliases rather than separate trailheads.

Skansberget/fornborg is an optional branch/alternate about 85 m off the local mainline, not the required Stage 20 mainline. Keep the mainline continuous and attach Skansberget as an optional side route with warnings; skip it in wind, heavy rain, low light, or with children, dogs, or large packs unless current conditions are confirmed.

If using OSM relation 5447840, do not trust raw member order as walking direction; assemble by shared endpoints for Henaredalen-to-Malmköping. Recommended OSM way order is 233436925 reversed, 233436922 reversed, 372184226 reversed, 366006656 reversed, 366006654 reversed, 372083671 forward, and 366192061 reversed.
Do not merge Lisätter access ways, the Skansberget optional loop, or Naturkartan's separate Led Henaredalen 1.4 km local route into the Stage 20 mainline. Present them as access/branch choices only.

Henaredalen-side transit is weak: no validated regular stop was verified within 2 km of the start, and Mortorp is a distant roughly 2.2 km straight-line fallback with sparse rural service. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken before planning around it.

Hosjöbadet/Malmköping local beach rules matter at the endpoint: no dogs on the main municipal beach, use the dog beach/access route with leash, no smoking, no fishing within the bathing area, and fires only at fixed municipal grill places when fire rules allow. 2025 bathing-water samples were acceptable and the 2026 season classification was excellent, but current seasonal advisories still need checking.

Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability, provides no shelter trash bins, and does not supply firewood. Carry out trash, bring water treatment/backup, and do not assume wood at Västersjön or Hosjöbadet.

facilities.name: Henaredalen / Västersjön stage start
facilities.description: Official stage-20 start coordinate near Västersjön and the stage-19 boundary.

facilities.name: Västersjön shelter
facilities.description: Substantial shelter just outside Henaredalen reserve at the stage start, with about 6 sleeping spots and Västersjön view.

facilities.name: Västersjön fire ring and grill
facilities.description: Fire ring a short distance from the shelter plus steel grill in front. Use only when current fire rules allow; the shelter/fireplace is just outside the reserve.

facilities.name: Västersjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet behind the shelter; separate OSM pin confirmed by official shelter/toilet context and hiker reports.

facilities.name: Västersjön tent/swim/lake-water context
facilities.description: Shelter source lists tent space, swimming, and water of unknown quality. Treat/filter any water and do not tent or make fires inside Henaredalen reserve.

facilities.name: Lisätter road-barrier parking
facilities.description: Practical access gate when the reserve parking is inaccessible. OSM maps this as a lift gate on the Lisätter access track; expect roughly 0.7 km to the Stage 20 mainline via access tracks, and verify current local signage before leaving a car.

facilities.name: Henaredalen reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules: no tenting, no fires, dogs/pets leashed year-round, no damaging trees/bushes, no flower picking/digging, no disturbing wildlife/eggs/nests, no motor vehicles, and no littering. Dead spruce from bark-beetle damage can fall.

facilities.name: Skansberget fornborg viewpoint
facilities.description: Optional branch/viewpoint over Henaren. Official and Länsstyrelsen recommend it, but the ascent is more demanding than the valley route.

facilities.name: Skansberget loop fallen-tree/navigation warning
facilities.description: 2025 comments report fallen trees, unclear turns, and difficult passage on the optional fornborg loop; one September 2025 report described it as not passable due fallen trees. Maintainer says it was re-marked but remains difficult. Treat as optional and potentially slow/blocked.

facilities.name: Helvetets port
facilities.description: Approximate route marker for the old narrow passage between rock outcrops on the historical Dunker-Hyltinge road. Sources conflict between about 1 km and 2 km from the start; no precise official point coordinate was verified.

facilities.name: Mörtsjön rest/view context
facilities.description: Small tarn/rest context along the stage; route-line pass-by is nearer 59.1385,16.7751 while this marker uses the OSM lake centroid. Treat as natural/untested lake water only, not a practical drinking-water refill; expect wet grass or muddy footing after rain.

facilities.name: Staven boundary cairn
