facilities.name: Stage 20/21 OSM handoff
facilities.description: OSM graph boundary shared by Stage 20 relation 5447840 and Stage 21 relation 3854541. The official Malmköping start/end coordinate is about 48 m away, so use this for graph stitching and the camping/Hosjöbadet pins for facilities.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping water point
facilities.description: Mapped water point at the endpoint camping/service area; Sörmlandsleden and Visit Flen list water refill at Malmköping camping. Service or seasonal access may apply.

facilities.name: Malmköpings Bad & Camping services
facilities.description: Paid camping/service node with camping/cabins/hostel context, toilets/showers, cafe/kiosk/restaurant and beach-area services. Opening hours and seasonality vary.

facilities.name: Hosjöbadet toilets, grill, and beach
facilities.description: Bathing area by the camping with toilets/changing hut, kiosk, grill places, jetties, accessibility ramp and beach rules. Naturkartan and local rules note no smoking or dogs on the main beach; use the separate dog beach. Fishing is not allowed within the municipal bathing area.

facilities.name: Hosjön grill place
facilities.description: Two fireplaces by Hosjöbadet/Malmköpings Bad & Camping. Bring your own firewood or charcoal and use only fixed grill places when current fire rules allow; stricter fire bans can also close fixed grills.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping parking
facilities.description: Parking by Malmköpings Bad & Camping / Hosjöbadet at the stage end; check local signs and camping/seasonal rules.

facilities.name: Hemköp Malmköping Torget
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply about 0.8 km from the camping/stage end. Opening hours and services should be checked live.

facilities.name: Coop Malmköping
facilities.description: Additional town grocery/resupply option; opening hours and services should be checked live.

facilities.name: Hotel Malmköping / town lodging
facilities.description: Hotel/restaurant and lodging option off the route in town, about 0.6-1 km from the stage-end context depending on path.

facilities.name: Malmköping busstation
facilities.description: Practical public-transit end point about 0.7-1 km from the camping/stage end, with regional bus lines. No regular train; Museispårvägen/Malmakvarn tram stops are seasonal heritage tram, not dependable onward transport.

facilities.name: Mortorp weak Henaredalen-side bus context
facilities.description: Nearest mapped Henaredalen-side bus fallback found in this pass, but it is about 2.2 km straight-line from the trailhead with sparse rural service. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on it.

facilities.name: Fishing and bathing-area rule warning
facilities.description: Fishing is forbidden within Flens municipal bathing areas such as Hosjöbadet, and other lakes/waters normally require checking fishing rights or a fishing card. Do not present fishing as automatically allowed.

sections.name: Stage 21: Malmköping to Hagtorp, väg 53
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 21, Malmköping to Hagtorp, väg 53.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun, Malmköping.
Malmköping/Hosjön is the strong start service node with paid camping/lodging, water, bathing, food, grocery, hotel/lodging, parking, toilets/showers, grill place, and bus access.
Hotel Malmköping sits early on the route by Plevnahöjden and is a practical opening-hour-dependent food/water/refill option.

Malmköping busstation is the real public-transport start access. Current terminal-map data lists a WC, but this should still be treated as station-facility-dependent rather than trail infrastructure. No regular train serves Malmköping; Museispårvägen/Malmakvarn/Hosjö are seasonal heritage tram stops, not commute rail.

There are no confirmed shelters or toilets between Malmköping and Hagtorp. Hagtorp/road 53 is mainly a rural road/trail endpoint; Bäckåsen is the practical nearby bus option. Sagostigen is seasonal/paid/off-route and should not be treated as a shortcut through the currently closed Rosmossen loop.
waterSources: Reliable water is at Malmköping services/camping before departure and the official natural spring at Sundbysjön after about 3 km.
Sundbysjön spring is natural/untested despite being officially listed; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.
Navestasjön, Nälen, and other wetland/lake contexts are natural water only and should not be shown as potable refills.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10.5 km; Naturkartan also lists 10.5 km and its current geometry measures about 10.598 km, Äventyrligare lists 10.58 km, OSM relation 3854541 measures about 10.59-10.62 km but is tagged 11 km and partly stale at the Malmköping start, and local official-GPX route geometry is about 10.37 km.

Route character: starts at Malmköping camping/Hosjön, climbs Plevnahöjden and Strömsholmsåsen, crosses Eskilstunavägen, continues through Malma reserve with Sundbysjön views and spring, then passes Navestasjön, the old overgrown road, Mordgrind, the moving-island pond, Nälen bird-lake context, and the 1876 execution site before Hagtorp/road 53.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Comments from 2023 praised waymarking; one 2023 report mentioned a single tree over the trail in Malma reserve that was easy to pass, and an August 2024 report warned of nettles/high meadow vegetation and light hilliness. A May 2025 AllTrails report described dry, well-maintained conditions with some hills and trafficked crossings.

Recent independent reports also note trafficked road crossings, road-adjacent walking, narrow/steep esker footing and benches/viewpoints on the ridges. A 2024 hiker report heard/seen traffic near road 53, crossed busy roads, found a substantial beaver-felled tree at a creek crossing, and still described the stage as very beautiful and well maintained.

Use local official-GPX-derived geometry for route-builder snapping: Stage 20/21 and 21/22 join exactly in local data. Naturkartan is also topologically clean, with Stage 20 ending exactly at Stage 21 start 59.139547667,16.731869529 and Stage 22 starting exactly at Stage 21 end 59.197098814,16.616318951. Treat official, Naturkartan, local and OSM endpoint coordinates as aliases rather than separate trailheads.

OSM relation 3854541 is graph-connected but should not be consumed in raw member order. The recommended Malmköping-to-Hagtorp way order is 372219224 reversed, 260509383 forward, 290703200 forward, 133302174 reversed, 290703201 reversed, 290703203 forward, 290703198 reversed, 1351896052 reversed, 290137322 reversed, 290137319 forward, 449055660 forward, 290137340 forward, 290137357 forward, 290137361 forward, 1295267625 forward, 290137317 forward, 1294590071 forward, 1294590072 forward, 290137318 forward, 290137312 forward, 290137321 forward, 290137314 forward, 290137326 forward, 290137315 forward, and 290137349 reversed.
Grazing animals matter: Sörmlandsleden and Naturkartan both warn that heifers/bulls can occur in Malma reserve, and horses/sheep can occur near Hagtorp.

Malma reserve rules: no loose dogs or other free-running pets, no tenting or caravan setup, fires only at assigned places, no parking outside prepared places, no damaging geological formations, plants, trees or bushes, no disturbing wildlife, and riding only where permitted.

Malmköpings reserve near the start has old forest and bark-beetle/dead-spruce context; Länsstyrelsen removed hazardous dead trees in 2023 but still warns that some dead trees can fall. Do not damage living or dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi or lichens, and organized camp activity requires permission.

Do not show a wind shelter or verified public toilet between Hosjöbadet/Malmköping and Hagtorp on Stage 21 itself. The next clear hiking shelter is Hällaren on Stage 22, about 4 km after Hagtorp. Sagostigen near Hagtorp is seasonal/paid/off-route and should be treated as a deliberate detour, not a dependable trail facility or trail shortcut.

Rundslinga 22.2/Rosmossen is currently closed for safety because of severe bark-beetle-damaged forest; do not recommend Sagostigen/Rosmossen as an alternate continuation unless Sörmlandsleden updates that closure.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping water point
facilities.description: Mapped water point by Malmköpings Bad & Camping / Hosjön. Strongest reliable refill before Sundbysjön, but service/seasonal access can matter.

facilities.name: Malmköpings Bad & Camping services
facilities.description: Paid camping/service start with toilets, showers, kitchen, drinking-water context, cabins/youth-hostel/camping, cafe/restaurant/kiosk context, sauna and beach access. Opening hours and customer/seasonal access vary.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping parking
facilities.description: Parking/access by Malmköpings Bad & Camping / Hosjöbadet at the stage start; check local signs and camping/seasonal rules.

facilities.name: Hosjöbadet toilets and bathing services
facilities.description: Municipal bathing area by the stage start with toilets, changing hut, kiosk, grill, dog-bath context, camping/cabins nearby, jetties and accessibility ramp. Services and sampling are seasonal.

facilities.name: Hosjöbadet beach rules
facilities.description: Municipal beach rules: no dogs on the main beach except designated dog-bath/access areas, no smoking, no fishing in the bathing area, and bathing-water sampling is seasonal. 2026 official sampling season is June 21-August 15.

facilities.name: Hosjön grill place
facilities.description: Two fireplaces by Hosjöbadet/Malmköpings Bad & Camping. Bring your own firewood or charcoal and use only when current fire rules allow; fire bans override fixed grill places.

facilities.name: Hemköp Malmköping Torget
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply in town before/near the start. Check current opening hours before relying on it.

facilities.name: Coop Malmköping
facilities.description: Additional town grocery/resupply option about 0.7-0.8 km from the stage start. Opening hours should be checked live.

facilities.name: Malmköpings Wärdshus
facilities.description: Nearby restaurant/lodging in Malmköping town, about 0.8-1 km from the stage-start context. Opening hours and booking availability should be checked live.

facilities.name: Malmköping busstation
facilities.description: Practical start access about 0.7 km/10 minutes from the stage start, with regional bus lines including 337, 430, 479, 690, 691, 701 and 801 in terminal-map context. Terminal-map data lists WC, but verify live/local availability; no regular train serves Malmköping and heritage tram stops are not commute rail.

facilities.name: Hotel Malmköping refill/services
facilities.description: Hotel/restaurant and possible water/provisions option early on the stage by Plevnahöjden; opening-hour and customer-service dependent.

facilities.name: Plevnahöjden / Malmabacken
facilities.description: Early ridge/high-point context with historical military associations and benches/views before the trail follows Strömsholmsåsen; expect narrow/steep esker footing in places.

facilities.name: Malmköping reserve dead-tree and rules context
facilities.description: Old-forest reserve near the start. Dead spruce was removed from trails in 2023, but Länsstyrelsen still warns some dead trees can fall; do not damage living/dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi or lichens, and organized camp activity/competitions require permission.

facilities.name: Malma reserve grazing and rules
facilities.description: Heifers/bulls can occur north of Sundbyvägen and sheep south of it. No loose dogs, no tenting/caravans, fires only at assigned places, no parking outside prepared places, no unauthorized riding, and avoid damaging plants/trees/geology.

facilities.name: Malma reserve / Smedstavägen access
facilities.description: Reserve-side parking/info-board access along road 53 between the two grazing enclosures. Useful bailout/access but verify current road/parking signs.

facilities.name: Smedstavägen bus access
facilities.description: Mid-stage bus/bailout context near Malma reserve, named by Länsstyrelsen for access. It is access, not services; check live service before planning around it.

facilities.name: Sundbysjön spring
facilities.description: Official spring after about 3 km with views over Sundbysjön/Dunkerbygden. Natural source: filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Sundbysjön rest/source area
facilities.description: Rest context near the spring and bird-rich Sundbysjön. Do not treat the lake/wetland as potable water.

facilities.name: Navestasjön
facilities.description: Natural lake/view context before the old overgrown road and Mordgrind. Lake water only, not a mapped refill.

facilities.name: Mordgrind
facilities.description: Historic murder site where engineer Herman Upmark was killed in 1874; Hjert and Tector were later the last publicly executed people in Sweden. Approximate route-derived pin; no exact mapped POI was verified.

facilities.name: Moving-island pond / Smedkärret candidate
facilities.description: Inferred marker for the official moving-island pond story near Navesta, likely Smedkärret with an underground connection to Akaren. Exact official pond name is not explicit; treat as approximate.

facilities.name: Nälen bird-lake context
facilities.description: Lake glimpsed from the route; official text notes Stone Age settlement finds and describes Nälen as one of Sörmland's notable bird lakes. Natural water only.

facilities.name: Hagtorp horse/sheep pasture warning
facilities.description: Near the end before Hagtorp, horses and sheep can occur along the trail. Keep dogs controlled, give animals space, and close gates.

facilities.name: Hjert execution site / Lidamon
facilities.description: Approximate marker for the Lidamon/gallows/execution-place context before the endpoint; Hjert was publicly executed here in 1876. No precise public coordinate was verified, and occasional secondary-source date errors should be ignored.

facilities.name: Hagtorp / road 53 stage end
facilities.description: Stage-21/22 boundary near road 53. Endpoint is not a service hub and no dedicated public parking was verified; use live planning for road/bus logistics and watch traffic at the road edge.

facilities.name: Bäckåsen bus access
facilities.description: Practical nearby bus option roughly 1 km from the Hagtorp endpoint; useful for stage-21 exit planning only when service is running. Weekday, school-day, weekend and roadwork/replacement patterns can differ, so verify current Sörmlandstrafiken departures day-of.

facilities.name: Sagostigen seasonal cafe/toilets/parking detour
facilities.description: Seasonal paid attraction near the Hagtorp end, about 1-1.5 km off the stage endpoint depending on route. For 2026 it lists opening May 14-August 23 plus August 29-30, with cafe generally 10-16 in season and paid-entry toilet/parking context. Treat as a deliberate detour, not an on-route facility or shortcut through Rosmossen while 22.2 is closed.

facilities.name: Landsvägsgatan road crossing
facilities.description: Road-crossing/approach context near the early stage after Malmköping. Use care with dogs, children and low visibility.

facilities.name: Eskilstunavägen / road 53-55 crossing
facilities.description: Primary-road approach/crossing cluster. User reports mention trafficked crossings and road noise/visibility in this stage segment.

facilities.name: Route 53 crossing / road-adjacent point
facilities.description: Mid-stage route-53 crossing or road-adjacent context; pause and confirm the marked line before crossing.

facilities.name: Ekebyvägen road crossing
facilities.description: Rural-road crossing/context in the later half of Stage 21. Watch for traffic and visibility, especially at dusk or with dogs.

facilities.name: Hagtorp road 53 endpoint crossing
facilities.description: Road-53 endpoint context at Hagtorp. The stage end is not a service hub, so plan pickup/bus logistics away from traffic.

facilities.name: Stage 21 hunting-season awareness
facilities.description: Seasonal hunting awareness, not a closure: Södermanland elk hunting commonly runs October 8-January 31 in licensed/management areas, with short calf hunting on unregistered land. Wear high visibility and respect posted hunt notices.

facilities.name: Stage 21 nettles/meadow vegetation
facilities.description: August 2024 official-page comment warned of lots of meadow/nettle wading and recommended long trousers. Expect seasonal vegetation and tick exposure in pasture/meadow parts.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Stage lakes and wetland contexts are not automatic fishing opportunities. Fishing in inland waters generally requires checking fishing rights or buying a fishing card unless a local free-fishing exception is verified.

sections.name: Stage 22: Hagtorp, väg 53 to Hälleforsnäs
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 22, Hagtorp, väg 53 to Hälleforsnäs.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun, Flens kommun, Hälleforsnäs.

Hällaren and Bruksdammen are the main shelter/rest nodes. Hällaren has a first-come shelter, reported fireplace/grill, dry-toilet context and unsampled lake/swim context; Bruksdammen has shelter, grill/fireplace, fishing pier and accessible toilet on the island.

The Hagtorp/road 53 start has weak public transport and no Rosmossen reserve parking. Bäckåsen bus stop is the practical nearby access, roughly 1 km away, but service can be weekday/school-day limited; check live Sörmlandstrafiken.

Stage 22 ends at the Bruksdammen/Hälleforsnäs stage junction, not at Hälleforsnäs station. Station and town services are reached via the 22:1 connector/Bruksslingan access: bus/train, Coop/groceries, restaurants/cafes and Bäckstugan B&B. Accessibility claims belong to Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen boardwalks, not the full Stage 22.
waterSources: The official on-stage refill is the cold spring south of Holmsjön/Hellmanstorp; treat/filter and remember Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability.
Hällaren, Bruksdammen, Holmsjön and other lakes/wetlands are natural surface water only. Filter/boil/treat if used.
Hälleforsnäs town services can provide reliable water after the walkout via 22:1, subject to opening hours.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 16.5 km; Naturkartan also lists 16.5 km and its current API geometry measures about 15.93 km, OSM relation 3854542 computes about 16.305 km but is tagged 16 km, Äventyrligare lists about 16.29 km, and local official-GPX geometry is about 15.813 km. Use 16.5 km as canonical.

Use the local official-GPX node for route-builder snapping: Stage 21 meets Stage 22 at 59.197177479,16.617192612, and Stage 22 meets Stage 23, 22:1 and 23:2 at the Bruksdammen junction near 59.157932680,16.468506047. Official, Naturkartan and OSM endpoint coordinates are nearby aliases, not separate trailheads.

Naturkartan topology is clean for Stage 22: Stage 21 site 85954 ends exactly at Stage 22 start 59.197098814,16.616318951, and Stage 22 site 85955 ends exactly at Stage 23:2 start 59.158013456,16.468586290. Stage 23 Naturkartan geometry is reversed relative its title, so orient by intended stage direction when ingesting.

OSM relation 3854542 is connected but raw member order is misordered and has multi-kilometre jumps. Recommended Hagtorp-to-Hälleforsnäs way order is 290137355 reversed, 290137353 forward, 290137346 reversed, 290137329 forward, 290137331 reversed, 290137308 forward, 290137328 forward, 290137334 reversed, 290137316 forward, 1001819926 forward, 1001819925 forward, 290137313 forward, 290137352 forward, 290137354 forward, and 246698674 reversed.
Rundslinga 22.2 through Rosmossen is currently closed for safety because bark-beetle-damaged spruce can fall. Do not present that side loop as open, but the main stage is still described as passable.

Official 2026-04-22 warning: planned nature-conservation burning in Stora Fjällsjön reserve during suitable conditions in weeks 18-44 may cause strong smoke on burn day and for days after, and temporary staff-controlled passage along about 200 m of gravel-road trail. Staff on site can temporarily stop passage.

Recent official/user reports mention wind-thrown trees south of Gårmossen and trees over a boardwalk near Holmsjön, including an October 2025 report after earlier 2024 clearing. Avoid dead-spruce areas in strong wind or heavy rain.

Rosmossen, Holmsjöberg and Stora Fjällsjön reserve rules protect living/dead trees, plants, fungi/lichens and wildlife; organized camps or competitions need Länsstyrelsen permission. Do not mark any reserve service facilities inside Stora Fjällsjön.

No formal campsite was verified on the stage, and reports describe poor tent ground at Hällaren, tiny/limited tent options near Stora Gyringen, and unsafe/poor tent ground near Pilati sjö because of dead or broken trees. Single-night tenting may fall under allemansrätten outside sensitive/reserve restrictions, but avoid wet ground, private zones, dead-tree areas and reserve-rule conflicts.

Dogs should be kept tightly controlled, especially March 1-August 20, near grazing animals, wetlands and reserves. Autumn/winter hunting may occur; heed signs, wear visible colours and keep dogs controlled.

facilities.name: Hagtorp / road 53 stage start
facilities.description: Official stage-22 start. Direct services are weak and no Rosmossen reserve parking is available; plan access via nearby Bäckåsen or through-hike from stage 21, and stay clear of road traffic while waiting.

facilities.name: Bäckåsen bus access
facilities.description: Practical nearby bus option roughly 1 km from the Hagtorp/road 53 start; one OSM stop side has shelter context. Service can be weekday/school-day limited or disruption-dependent, so verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures day-of.

facilities.name: Sagostigen seasonal cafe/toilets/parking detour
facilities.description: Seasonal paid attraction near the Hagtorp start, off the main stage. For 2026 it lists opening May 14-August 23 plus August 29-30, with cafe generally 10-16 in season and paid-entry toilet/parking context. Treat as a deliberate detour only.

facilities.name: Rosmossen loop closure
facilities.description: Rundslinga 22.2/Rosmossen is closed for safety due severe spruce-bark-beetle damage and falling-tree risk. This is a side-loop closure only; the Stage 22 mainline remains separately described as passable.

facilities.name: Stage 22 dog and hunting-season awareness
facilities.description: Keep dogs tightly controlled, especially March 1-August 20 and near grazing animals, wetlands and reserves. Autumn/winter hunting may occur; heed signs, wear visible colours and do not disturb active hunting.

facilities.name: Hällaren shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after roughly 4 km. Free/shared first-come shelter; no booking and no rubbish bins. Hiker reports describe it as dry, well-kept and popular; store food defensively because mice have been reported, and do not assume tentable ground nearby.

facilities.name: Hällaren fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Reported established fireplace/grill at the shelter. Use only when fire rules allow, do not collect reserve wood, and do not rely on firewood being present.

facilities.name: Hällaren dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet reported behind/up in the woods from the shelter, including a 2024 report of a double dry toilet. Verify current condition on site.

facilities.name: Hällaren swimming/lake-water context
facilities.description: Informal swimming/lake-water context; official text says suitable swimming is toward the lake's south end, while the shelter is farther along the west shore. This is not a municipal sampled bathing place and has no lifeguard; lake water only, filter/boil/treat if used.

facilities.name: Hällaren approach navigation caveat
facilities.description: Hiker reports warn that some maps may tempt you along the lake shore; follow orange markings and leave the gravel road near the house/grass field roughly 400 m before the shelter.

facilities.name: Stora Gyringen rest area
facilities.description: Official/municipal text identifies Stora Gyringen as a good rest spot along Stage 22. This is a lake/rest context, not a shelter, toilet, or drinking-water point; hiker reports describe tiny/limited tent possibilities and wet bog vegetation nearby.

facilities.name: Gårmossen/Holmsjön windfall warning
facilities.description: October 2025 official-page comment reported several wind-thrown trees south of Gårmossen and trees over boardwalk nearer Holmsjön, despite earlier 2024 clearing reports. Approximate hazard band toward the spring; avoid dead-spruce areas in strong wind/heavy rain.

facilities.name: Stage 22 wet bog and boardwalk footing
facilities.description: After rain, hiker reports describe soaked vegetation, wet/slippery boardwalks, boggy areas and thigh-high shrubs around Gyringen/Holmsjön. Expect wet boots and slower progress in poor weather.

facilities.name: Holmsjön south spring
facilities.description: Official cold spring south of Holmsjön/after the Eskilstunavägen crossing, with matching OSM spring/drinking-water nodes nearby. Natural source: water availability/quality is not guaranteed; treat/filter. A 2024 blog found it flowing well, but that is not a guarantee.

facilities.name: Hellmanstorp/Eskilstunavägen winter parking caution
facilities.description: Small parking/access near the Hellmanstorp road crossing; official notes warn it is often unusable after snow because plowed snow blocks access. Treat as conditional, not reliable winter parking.

facilities.name: Stora Fjällsjön 2026 burn/smoke warning
facilities.description: Active 2026 warning: conservation burning may affect smoke/access during weeks 18-44 when conditions fit. Strong smoke can occur on burn day and for days after; about 200 m of gravel-road trail may be staff-controlled and temporarily stopped during operations.

facilities.name: Stage 22 reserve rule context
facilities.description: Rosmossen, Holmsjöberg and Stora Fjällsjön reserve rules protect living/dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi/lichens and wildlife; organized camps or competitions need permission. Do not collect reserve wood for fires, and do not add off-route Stora Fjällsjön/Botvidstäppan BBQ nodes as Stage 22 facilities.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen shelter
facilities.description: Shelter/rest node on the Bruksdammen island near the stage end and Bruksslingan. OSM and official coordinates differ by only a short distance.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen grill/fireplace
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace on the Bruksdammen island. Follow fire bans and local rules.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen accessible toilet
facilities.description: Accessible toilet on the Bruksdammen island; Bruksslingan notes the toilet is closed in winter. Accessibility applies to Bruksslingan/boardwalk access, not the full Stage 22.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen fishing pier
facilities.description: Fishing-pier/rest context on the island. Exact pier pin not separately verified, so marker stays with the Bruksdammen facility cluster; the pier does not mean free fishing.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Fishing is not part of allemansrätten in inland waters. Check local fishing rights or buy the required fishing card before using Bruksdammen or nearby lakes; a fishing pier does not mean free fishing.

facilities.name: Bruksslingan / Edströmsvallen access
facilities.description: Accessible 4 km Bruksslingan/start-access context near Edströmsvallen; the official loop includes a 1.3 m wide boardwalk to the island and is useful for parking/access toward the stage end.

facilities.name: Vaggande stenen
facilities.description: Rocking stone about 1 km before Hälleforsnäs. Coordinate comes from an official-page user comment; treat as approximate field-check marker.

facilities.name: Bruksskolan bus stop
facilities.description: Nearest regular town-bus context for the Bruksdammen/Hälleforsnäs end, about 1.7 km from the Stage 22 endpoint. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station
facilities.description: Rail/bus access via connector 22:1 from the stage end/Bruksdammen area; direct distance is just over 2 km from the main-stage endpoint, but it is official via the connector. Do not assume station-side food, toilet or water.

facilities.name: Coop Hälleforsnäs
facilities.description: Town grocery/resupply after the walkout from Bruksdammen/22:1. Check current opening hours.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs bruk restaurants/cafes
facilities.description: Bruket area has restaurant/cafe/pizza/bakery options such as Bruksrestaurangen and Femhundra Grader. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Hiker-oriented B&B near Sörmlandsleden in Hälleforsnäs with kitchen/WC/shower; verify availability before relying on it.

sections.name: Stage 22:1: Hälleforsnäs jvstn to Edströmsvallen
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 22:1, Hälleforsnäs jvstn to Edströmsvallen.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun, Hälleforsnäs.
Hälleforsnäs station is the official connector start with train/bus access, platform shelter context and listed parking; station-side food/toilet/water services should not be assumed.

Edströmsvallen is the official 22:1 connector end. Edströmsvallen and Bruket/Turistbyrån are practical parking/service starts for Bruksslingan, but event toilets/kiosk should not be treated as always-available trail services.

Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen nearby has shelter, grill/fireplace, fishing pier, picnic/rest places and accessible toilet, but those are continuation/loop facilities after the short station connector itself.

Start access is strongest at Hälleforsnäs station, with Mälartåg train service and bus 415 toward Flen. Check same-day Mälartåg/Sörmlandstrafiken departures and replacement-bus locations before committing.
waterSources: No confirmed public drinking-water tap was verified on stage 22:1 itself.

Use Hälleforsnäs/Bruket businesses, Coop, or the motorhome stop only when open/available; do not treat Bruksdammen, Bruksslingan wetlands, the motorhome stop, or its toilet as free public trail drinking-water sources.
If arriving from stage 22, the official Holmsjön south spring is the previous trail water source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 1.5 km from Hälleforsnäs railway station to Edströmsvallen/Bruksslingan. OSM relation 9636667 measures about 1.45 km and has the correct name/from/to/website but a wrong ref=21:1 tag, so show the official 22:1 label.

The route is split at the official connector end near OSM node 2540056176, 59.1564234,16.4869276. The longer Edströmsvallen-to-Bruksdammen walk is Bruksslingan/access continuation context, not part of the official 22:1 distance.

This is a signed access connector. After about 1.5 km it reaches Bruksslingan; roughly 500-600 m counter-clockwise on Bruksslingan reaches the first shared Stage 22/Bruksslingan node around 59.1591799,16.4779508, and the Bruksdammen information-board/junction cluster sits around 59.15805,16.4686.
Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Bruksslingan also showed no current faults, but its accessible toilet is closed in winter.

Winter reports describe the station-to-Edströmsvallen connector as sometimes icy, with snow hiding sparse markings in places. Treat winter accessibility and footing separately from Bruksslingan's reviewed winter maintenance and summer accessibility claims.

Surface is more village/cycleway/old-railway-bank connector than wilderness trail; local sources describe Gamla banvallen as walking/cycling access toward Edströmsvallen/Bruket, and hiker reports treat 22:1 more as transit access than a scenic standalone hike.

Do not mark Stage 22:1 itself as wheelchair-accessible unless field-verified. The verified accessibility claim belongs to Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen boardwalks, including the 1.3 m wide boardwalk to the island.
The Bruket/Edströmsvallen area is a mixed heritage, business and event area. Respect buildings, fences, yards, events and signed/private areas; do not camp, dig or disturb industrial-legacy ground.

Temporary access note checked 2026-04-28: Mälartåg listed April 27-May 1 disruption work, including April 27-30 train 2172 cancelled Hälleforsnäs-Västerås with replacement bus. Always verify live rail/bus status for this transit-first connector.

facilities.description: Use only prepared fireplaces and only when current fire rules allow; check Brandrisk Ute/Krisinformation. Do not camp informally in public, business or event areas around Bruket/Edströmsvallen.

facilities.name: Stage 22:1 winter ice/marking caveat
facilities.description: A winter trip report described the station-to-Edströmsvallen connector as icy in places, with some markings sparse or hidden by snow. Winter can reduce accessibility on connector paths and boardwalks; use poles/traction as needed.

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Hiker-oriented B&B near Sörmlandsleden in Hälleforsnäs with 6-7 beds, kitchen, WC/shower context; coordinate is approximate and availability must be checked.

sections.name: Stage 23: Hälleforsnäs to Svalboviken
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 23, Hälleforsnäs to Svalboviken.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun, Flens kommun, Hälleforsnäs, Katrineholms kommun.
Hälleforsnäs/Bruket is the service side: rail/bus via station and 22:1, grocery, restaurants/cafes, lodging and parking at Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket.
There is no parking at the exact stage-23 start; use Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket and walk in.

Mögsjön is the key mid-stage overnight/rest node with shelter, dry toilet, picnic/rest context, fireplace/grill context and official suitable tent spots. Svalboviken is a rural road endpoint with parking context from stage 24, but no shop, toilet, tap or dependable walk-up transit.
waterSources: Fyrsjön well is the only official stage water point, about 1.5 km after the start. It may need priming and Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee tested potable quality, so treat/filter and carry backup.
Mögsjön, Fyrsjön, Båven/Svalboviken-area lakes and other lakes are natural surface water only.
If continuing onto stage 24, the Svalboviken south source is listed with uncertain quality; do not assume it as reliable.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 12 km. OSM relation 3925449 is the correct Stage 23 relation and computes around 11.7 km, but its distance tag still says 13 km; older/third-party material may also show 13 km. AllTrails/Naturkartan cross-checks are consistent with roughly 11.7-12.0 km and moderate, rolling terrain.

Draw Stage 23 as the mainline Hälleforsnäs/Bruksdammen junction to Svalboviken segment, including the final road walk northwest to the stage-24 start. Do not include 22:1, 23:1, 23:2, 24 or 24:3 unless selected as access/branch routes.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. A March 2024 comment reported clear-cuts, fallen trees and unclear marking around Ramsbäck-Mögsjön, while later 2024 and June 2025 comments were positive and described the stage as well maintained with good boardwalks.

After Mögsjön the route has around 3 km of moss/myr/boardwalk terrain toward the Hälleforsnäs-Svalboviken road. Expect slippery boardwalks, wet ground and slower footing after rain or frost even when the stage is passable.

The route follows or edges Långmossen. Where the route enters the Långmossen nature reserve, its rules prohibit camping, fires, motor vehicles, unleashed dogs, tree/dead-wood damage and most plant picking; outside the reserve, follow posted signs and allemansrätten.
Båven is Natura 2000 with bird-protection areas and extended shoreline protections in places. Obey signed seasonal access bans and avoid shore/island detours that are not clearly open.
Mögsjön shelter is free/shared/first-come, not bookable, and firewood is not supplied. Use the established fireplace only when current fire-ban status allows it.

Skogsstyrelsen forestry notices from 2023 and 2025 lie close to or cross the route near Fyrsjön/Fågelhäll and Svalboviken; keep current markings/GPX visible through clear-cut areas. Camping near Svalboviken can be awkward because of clear-cuts, road noise and sparse services.

facilities.name: Mögsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 6.5 km. Shared first-come shelter, not bookable; OSM maps the shelter cluster close by and recent comments describe the area as well maintained.

facilities.description: Picnic/rest table mapped at the Mögsjön shelter cluster; useful as the main mid-stage rest stop.

facilities.description: Official suitable tent spots near the shelter; reports say flatter tenting may be easier slightly south/closer to the lake than directly by the shelter rock. Lake water only, and swimming access is informal/rough.

facilities.description: Shelter fire/cooking context. Sörmlandsleden says shelters have grill/fireplace but does not supply firewood; check fire bans and only use established places.

facilities.description: Forestry notices from 2023/2025 lie close to the route near Fyrsjön/Fågelhäll and Svalboviken. Clear-cuts can make markings harder to follow; keep GPX/current signs visible.

facilities.name: Båven protection/fishing caveat
facilities.description: Lake Båven has Natura 2000, bird-protection and shoreline-protection contexts. Fishing generally requires checking permits, and Visit Flen notes Båven fishing is from islands or boat only.

facilities.name: Svalboviken parking/access
facilities.description: Stage-23 end/stage-24 start with good parking per official stage 24. Rural endpoint with weak transit and no robust services.

facilities.name: Svalboviken weak-transit caveat

facilities.description: Nearest mapped rural bus context found during research, roughly 3 km by road from Svalboviken; sparse/route-dependent and not a dependable endpoint service without live verification.

sections.name: Stage 23:1: Flen (Hammarvallen) to Harpsundsvägen
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 23:1, Flen (Hammarvallen) to Harpsundsvägen.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun.

Flen is the practical service base, with rail/bus access at Flen station, station toilet/service context, grocery/food options in town, and Hammarvallen parking/start facilities nearby. Local Flen transit changed in December 2025 to app-booked 'När du vill' traffic on weekdays, so plan the station-to-start leg with live Sörmlandstrafiken or walk it.

Hammarvallen has sports/swimming-hall facilities with opening-hour or paid-entry-dependent toilets/changing; Flens Bowlingcafé at Hammarvallen is a separate opening-hour-dependent food/fika option, not an all-hours trail service.
Lida Gård is an official alternate start/parking option with opening-hour-dependent restaurant/cafe/shop service; starting there adds distance compared with Hammarvallen.

No on-stage shelter, toilet, shop, or all-hours tap was verified after leaving Flen/Hammarvallen. Harpsundsvägen is a roadside stage-change point with no confirmed parking or services, so plan pickup, continue to 23:2, or arrange transport carefully.

Orrhammaren has route-adjacent swim/rest opportunities, but the formal serviced public beach is Orrestaöbadet across the lake/off the core trail. Do not treat private Orrhammaren bathing areas as guaranteed public facilities.
waterSources: Carry water from Flen, Hammarvallen, or Lida. The only verified on-stage water point is Vikmanstorp spring after about 7 km, and Sörmlandsleden explicitly warns that it is unreliable in summer and may dry out.
Orrhammaren and nearby lakes are natural/untested water only. Treat/filter any natural water and do not count beach or private-facility services as a trail refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10 km from Flen/Hammarvallen to Harpsundsvägen. OSM relation 9637570 is the correct Stage 23:1 relation, but it includes a disconnected Lida Gård alternate-start branch; the main component is about 10.2 km, while all relation members total about 13 km.
Treat 23:1 and 23:2 as the two halves of the Flen-Hälleforsnäs connection, handing off at the same Harpsundsvägen trailhead. Do not stitch 23:1 into the main Stage 23 Hälleforsnäs-Svalboviken route.
Third-party maps and station-access variants range roughly from 9.4-11.6 km, and the Lida Gård-Harpsundsvägen variant is about 13.5 km. Keep official 10 km for the Hammarvallen start.

Official Sörmlandsleden and current local listings show the stage active with no public fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Recent 2025 AllTrails reports were positive, but still treat wet boardwalks, roots and steep Orrhammaren footing as weather-dependent hazards.

Åtorpskogen nature reserve is crossed/edged by the route. Do not damage living or dead trees/shrubs, do not collect/damage invertebrate habitats, and avoid organized camps/competitions without permission. Dead bark-beetle-damaged spruce can fall, especially after wind or heavy rain.

A roughly 100 m boardwalk over stream/wet ground near Åtorpskogen/Orrhammaren can be slippery or springy when wet; older reports describe it as passable rather than closed. Flens local rules also restrict cycling/riding on municipal exercise tracks, and Sörmlandsleden is a hiking route.

Older hiker reports mention clear-cut or young-forest roughness between Orrhammarens fritidsområde and Vikmanstorp, but the trail was still preserved and later reports describe easy-to-follow orange marking. Keep the GPX/current markings visible.

Harpsundsvägen has no confirmed parking, toilet, water, shelter, or reliable transit right at the endpoint. Complementary rural traffic may require advance booking and should not be treated as casual trail-exit transit. Do not imply open public access to Harpsund residence, protected shoreline, boat facilities or restricted roads from this trail junction.

facilities.name: Flen station access

facilities.name: ICA Kvantum Flen
facilities.description: Practical grocery/resupply in central Flen before the stage. Check current opening hours.

facilities.name: Hammarvallen bus/local access context

facilities.description: Formal serviced public beach across the lake/off the core route, with seasonal toilets/changing/grill/camping context. Smoking and dogs are prohibited on the bathing place; 2026 bathing-water class was excellent, but check current samples seasonally.

facilities.description: Reserve rules apply and bark-beetle-damaged dead spruce can fall suddenly, especially in wind or after heavy rain.

facilities.description: Roadside stage-change point shared with stage 23:2. Sörmlandsleden 23:2 says no parking here; no toilet, tap, shelter, table, or reliable transit was verified.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen weak-transit caveat
facilities.description: Do not count on spontaneous endpoint transit. Plan pickup, continue on 23:2 to Hälleforsnäs, arrange taxi, or verify any complementary rural traffic well in advance.

facilities.name: Harpsund side-trip access caveat
facilities.description: Harpsund is a protected-object area. Follow all signs, barriers and photography/depiction restrictions; do not imply open public access to residence, shoreline, boat facilities, restricted roads or gates from this junction.

sections.name: Stage 23:2: Harpsundsvägen to Hälleforsnäs
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 23:2, Harpsundsvägen to Hälleforsnäs.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun, Hälleforsnäs.

Harpsundsvägen is the official start but has no official parking and no verified toilet, water, shelter, shop, or easy transit at the road junction. Plan a drop-off, continue from stage 23:1, or start/end from Hälleforsnäs instead.

Hälleforsnäs is the reliable service end: station access via the 22:1 connector, nearby parking at Edströmsvallen/Turistbyrån, Coop, restaurants/cafes, tourist information, Bruksdammen facilities, and lodging options. Verify current opening hours before depending on food or indoor toilets.

Hedsjön is the only confirmed overnight/rest node on the stage, with shelter, fireplace/grill context, a nearby toilet, and natural lake water. The toilet is reported 100-200 m north/toward Hälleforsnäs rather than directly beside the shelter.
waterSources: The only official/mapped water point is the spring north of Hedsjön at about 4.5 km. OSM tags it as drinking water and official sources list it as a spring, but Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee flow or tested potable quality; treat/filter/boil if unsure.
Hedsjön lake water is natural/untested. Hiker reports used it only after filtering, and lake access near the shelter is not a prepared beach or jetty.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official distance is 10 km. OSM relation 9636668 is the correct Stage 23:2 relation and measures around 10.3 km; Äventyrligare/AllTrails variants around 10.1-10.3 km are normal geometry differences.

Draw Stage 23:2 from Harpsundsvägen to the shared Hälleforsnäs/Bruksdammen stage junction west of Bruksdammen. Do not include Hälleforsnäs station in the core line; station access belongs to connector 22:1 and Bruksslingan access.
Stage 23:2 is the second half of the Flen-Hälleforsnäs connector and hands off from Stage 23:1 at Harpsundsvägen. At Hälleforsnäs it meets stages 22 and 23 around the Bruksdammen junction.

Official Sörmlandsleden page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. A 2022 hiker report described a rough/unclear logged section shortly after Harpsundsvägen and overgrown stretches near/north of Hedsjön; treat that as historical caution unless a newer report confirms it.

Route character is a short road walk toward Harpsund, forest path, crossings of Viks å, Hedsjön viewpoint/shelter, older overgrown farmland around Rösjötorp, old forest, charcoal-kiln remains, and final approach to the Bruksdammen/Hälleforsnäs junction.

Do not promote Harpsund as an easy side trip to see Harpsundsekan. Harpsund is a protected object: the point/udde is closed, protected shoreline/water areas are signed, visitor parking is limited and can close, and posted access, photography, depiction or measurement restrictions must be respected.

No designated tent site was verified on 23:2. Hedsjön shelter is first-come/shared and not bookable; discreet one-night tenting may be possible under allemansrätten where it does not disturb or damage, but check local signs and avoid farmland, private areas and any protected Harpsund zones.

Use established fire/grill places only, bring/expect no supplied firewood, pack out trash, and check current fire-ban status. No stage-specific nature reserve rule page was confirmed for Hedsjön/23:2 during this pass.

Hedsjön is not a municipal sampled bathing place; reports describe rocky/vegetated access rather than a prepared beach. Treat lake water and Viks å as natural water only, and avoid wading/swimming where footing or flow is uncertain.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen stage start, no parking
facilities.description: Official 23:2 start. Sörmlandsleden explicitly says no parking here; no toilet, tap, shelter, or reliable transit was verified at the road junction.

facilities.name: Harpsund protected-object caveat
facilities.description: Harpsund is a protected object. Access inside the protected area is prohibited; follow signs, fences and any posted photography/depiction/measurement restrictions. The point/udde is closed and visitor parking may close.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen clear-cut/marking historical caution
facilities.description: Historical 2022 hiker report described a rough, unclear clear-cut section shortly after the road-walk start, with old markings, high grass, branches and holes. Official page currently lists no faults, so treat this as stale-but-useful caution.

facilities.name: Viks å crossings
facilities.description: Route crosses Viks å in a couple of places. Natural stream context only, not a verified drinking-water source; expect variable wet footing or flow after rain.

facilities.name: Hedsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 4 km on the northeast side of Hedsjön. Free, shared, first-come, not bookable, with no guaranteed firewood or bins; 2022 hiker report found it weather-sturdy during heavy rain/wind.

facilities.name: Hedsjön shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Fire/grill context at the shelter area, supported by Sörmlandsleden's general shelter guidance and hiker reports rather than a separately surveyed official fireplace coordinate. Use only if current fire-ban status allows it.

facilities.name: Hedsjön toilet, approximate
facilities.description: Official sources confirm a toilet near Hedsjön, but exact coordinate was not published. Hiker/source comments place it roughly 100-200 m north/toward Hälleforsnäs from the shelter and note it can be easy to miss.

facilities.name: Hedsjön lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water near the shelter; not a potable refill. Hiker reports filtered it, and shoreline access is rocky/vegetated rather than a prepared beach or municipal sampled bathing place.

facilities.name: Spring north of Hedsjön
facilities.description: Only official/mapped water point on this stage, about 4.5 km from the start and about 1 km after Hedsjön. Treat/filter/boil if unsure; no recent source verifies year-round flow or tested potable quality.

facilities.name: Rösjötorp and charcoal remains
facilities.description: Approximate cultural-history corridor with old farmland, Rösjötorp ruin, a stone-lined pit likely connected to flax processing, charcoal-kiln bottoms, and charcoal-burner hut remains. Look but do not disturb.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs / Bruksdammen trail junction
facilities.description: Official end area west of Bruksdammen where stages 22, 23, and 23:2 meet. Not the railway station; use connector 22:1 for rail access.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen nearby shelter/fireplace
facilities.description: Nearby Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen shelter and grill context at the Hälleforsnäs end; useful endpoint service, not mid-stage.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen accessible toilet
facilities.description: Accessible toilet near Bruksdammen/Bruksslingan; official Bruksslingan information notes winter closure.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen / Edströmsvallen parking access
facilities.description: Use Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket parking for the Hälleforsnäs end; do not assume parking at the exact stage junction.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station connector
facilities.description: Rail/bus access via the official 22:1 connector, about 1.5 km from the station to Edströmsvallen/Bruksdammen.

facilities.name: Coop Hälleforsnäs
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply in Hälleforsnäs near the service end. Check current opening hours and payment status.

facilities.name: Bruket / Hälleforsnäs food and visitor services

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Trail-near Hälleforsnäs lodging with kitchen, WC/shower, and limited beds; coordinate approximate and availability must be checked.

sections.name: Stage 24: Svalboviken to Lundsjön
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 24, Svalboviken to Lundsjön.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun, Katrineholms kommun.

This is a long, service-sparse forest stage. Svalboviken has official parking at/near the start, and Lundsjön has parking described north of the endpoint in a former gravel pit, but neither trailhead has verified toilets, shops, restaurants, or potable taps.

Public transport is not trailhead-convenient. Nearby rural stops such as Knektbacken, Ramsta, Trekanten/Bie, Flodafors, or Bie require multi-kilometre road walks and current Sörmlandstrafiken verification; do not assume weekend or school-holiday service.
No on-stage toilet was verified. The next confirmed trail toilet is on stage 25 at Myrgryten, about 3.5 km after Lundsjön.

On-route overnight options are basic and limited: Kolarkoja has two sleeping places and Gruvtorpet is an open hut officially listed with four sleeping places. Do not expect bins, firewood, or indoor services.
waterSources: The only official on-stage water point is the spring about 2-2.5 km south of Svalboviken, and official text marks its quality as uncertain. OSM tags it as a spring/drinking-water point, but the app should keep the official treat/filter warning.

Svalbosjön/Svalboviken, Tryningen/Trynningen, and Lundsjön can be surface-water fallback points only. Hiker reports mention easier pier access at Svalbosjön and Lundsjön, while Tryningen shoreline access can be vegetated; treat/filter/boil all lake water.
Carry enough water for the full 16.5 km in warm weather unless prepared to filter uncertain natural sources.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 16.5 km; Naturkartan describes about 17 km but its GPX measures about 16.29 km, matching OSM relation 3925407 at about 16.29 km. OSM's distance=15 km tag is stale; keep official 16.5 km for display.

Draw Stage 24 as the directed Svalboviken-Lundsjön mainline. At Svalboviken it forms a three-way junction with Stage 23 and 24:3; at Lundsjön it hands off to Stage 25, whose OSM geometry may need reversing when chaining onward.

Official page showed no formal fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass, but a June 2025 official-page comment reports clear-cuts, young growth, bark-beetle damage, overgrown/narrow tread, obscured orange markings after forestry work, confusing orange forestry paint, wet/muddy sections, and wild-boar-disturbed ground.

Route character is a long, lonely forest stage with a tough initial climb to Tyckenhed, Eskilstuna municipality's high point, then managed forest, Tryningen, mining/charcoal-history remains, Gruvtorpet, a limited Lundsjön viewpoint, and a possible cattle pasture near Lundsjön.

No designated campsite was verified. Practical tenting is limited by hilly/vegetated terrain; recent comments describe Tryningen/Trynningen as one of the better areas, while older reports mention few flat spots and one improvised forest-road turnaround. Use ordinary allemansrätten care and avoid farmland, homes, sensitive ground, and grazing animals.

No stage-specific nature-reserve rule overlap was confirmed for the normal corridor. Nearby Kokärret reserve/Natura 2000 wetland is very wet, has no trails, parking or visitor facilities, and should not be used as an access/camping/service assumption.

Fireplaces are not strongly verified on stage 24 except reported hut/rest contexts. Use only clearly established safe fire/grill places if present, bring no expectation of supplied wood, never cut live/dead trees, and check current fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Svalboviken stage start and parking
facilities.description: Official stage start with good parking described by Sörmlandsleden. OSM did not confirm a formal mapped parking object, so verify signs and overnight rules locally.

facilities.name: Svalbovikens badplats
facilities.description: Nearby bathing/access context by Svalbosjön. Surface water only; not a potable refill. Some hikers have parked near the beach, but use official/local parking signs.

facilities.name: Knektbacken rural bus context
facilities.description: Nearest mapped rural bus context found east/southeast of Svalboviken, still about a 3 km road walk. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken before planning access.

facilities.name: Tyckenhed high point and steep first climb
facilities.description: Eskilstuna municipality high point, about 113.9 m. Expect a sustained early climb from Svalboviken; official text says the hill burned in 1947.

facilities.name: Spring south of Svalboviken
facilities.description: Official spring about 2-2.5 km south of Svalboviken. Quality is explicitly uncertain despite OSM drinking-water tagging; treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Kolarkoja basic hut
facilities.description: Basic charcoal hut about 2 km after Tyckenhed, with two sleeping slabs/places and a door. Reports mention fireplace/benches outside, but still treat as simple first-come shelter with no toilet, bin, or guaranteed firewood.

facilities.name: Tryningen / Trynningen rest and natural water
facilities.description: Rest context by Tryningen/Trynningen. Lake water is natural/untested; reeds and vegetation can make access awkward, though reports mention a rocky rest/swim point and good tent possibilities nearby.

facilities.name: Tryningen reported fireplace/rest context
facilities.description: Secondary reports mention fireplace/bench context near Tryningen, but no official maintained fireplace was verified. Use only if a safe established fireplace is present and current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Stage 24 forestry, marking, and overgrowth warning
facilities.description: June 2025 comment reports clear-cuts, young growth, bark-beetle damage, overgrown/narrow trail, obscured markings after forestry work, confusing orange forestry paint, mud, and wild-boar-tracked ground despite no formal official fault report.

facilities.name: Kokärret nearby reserve caveat
facilities.description: Nearby wetland reserve/Natura 2000 area with no visitor facilities, trails or parking. Very wet unstable ground; do not use it as a shortcut, campsite, water/service stop, or access assumption.

facilities.name: Gruvtorpet open hut
facilities.description: Open overnight hut in a former outbuilding. Official lodging text lists four sleeping places; third-party shelter sources report up to six and field reports call it functional/basic, so plan for the lower capacity.

facilities.name: Gruvtorpet mining remains
facilities.description: Historic mining/torp context around Gruvtorpet and the late-stage forest. Look but do not disturb cultural remains.

facilities.name: Lundsjön pasture and cattle warning
facilities.description: Official text notes cattle may graze near Lundsjön and that the road can be used to go around the pasture. Keep distance and control dogs.

facilities.name: Lundsjön stage end
facilities.description: Stage 24 end and stage 25 start. No toilet, shop, or potable tap was verified at the endpoint.

facilities.name: Lundsjön nearby parking, approximate
facilities.description: Approximate parking context. Stage 24 says parking is about 250 m north in a former gravel pit, while stage 25 mentions possible parking about 100 m southwest by forest road; exact mapped lot and capacity were not verified.

facilities.name: Norra Vinstugan off-route lodging
facilities.description: Book-ahead timber-cabin lodging listed by Sörmlandsleden for Stage 24, about 650 m from the trail and 4-5 km north of Lundsjön; private/opening-dependent service with WC/shower/kitchenette context.

facilities.name: Ramsta rural bus context
facilities.description: Wider-area bus stop about 3 km east of Lundsjön, not a trailhead stop. Verify current Sörmlandstrafiken service before planning a road walk.

facilities.name: Bie rural bus/service context
facilities.description: Wider-area bus/service village more than 3 km west of Lundsjön. Useful only with a substantial road walk and current timetable verification; do not treat as on-stage resupply.

facilities.name: Magdakullan off-route seasonal services
facilities.description: Far off-route farm shop/cafe/restaurant/lodging/InfoPoint context north-west of the stage area, roughly 6 km from the route. Seasonal and opening-hour dependent; not an on-route resupply.

sections.name: Stage 24:1: Vilsta, Eskilstuna to Hållsta
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 24:1, Vilsta, Eskilstuna to Hållsta.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun.

Vilsta is the strong service/access start, with bus line 6 context from Eskilstuna, parking near Vilsta raststuga, toilets, designated grill places, lodging/camping, restaurant/cafe context, and nearby bathing facilities.

Skjulsta is a side-trip/access service cluster about 400 m from the trail, with parking, cafe, toilets, grill places, bathing, exercise tracks and Uvberget access. Treat it as a detour/service cluster, not an on-route facility line.
No official shelter, dependable on-stage toilet, or reliable mid-stage drinking water was verified between the Vilsta/Skjulsta service area and Hållsta.

Hållsta endpoint has no official parking at the stage start. The nearest bus context is Åläng/Hållsta village to the west/northwest; current public maps show line 19 Hållsta-Bälgviken and night bus 65, while older Sörmlandsleden text may still mention bus 9. Hållsta badplats is an off-route village facility with toilet, grill and bathing context, not a guaranteed trailhead service.
waterSources: The only official natural water point is the Piltorp/Dalkarlstorp spring, but the official page says it is not accessible as of a 2025-05 report. Mark it as unavailable and do not rely on it until reverified.

Carry drinking water from Vilsta/Eskilstuna or from verified staffed services. Surface water around Skjulsta/Eskilstunaån and Hållsta badplats is natural/untested and should not be presented as drinking water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official and Naturkartan distance is 12 km. OSM relation 9631287 is the correct Stage 24:1 relation and measures about 11.4 km; AllTrails around 10.9 km, RouteYou around 8 km and Äventyrligare around 15 km should not replace the official display distance.

Draw Stage 24:1 as a standalone Vilsta-Hållsta connector. It hands off to 24:2 at Hållsta and the 24:1-24:3 branch eventually reaches the main trail at Svalboviken, but 24:2/24:3, Skjulsta/Karl IX canal, Vilstarundan, and parking connectors should remain separate from the core 24:1 line.

OSM relation 9631287 is topologically continuous and shares its Hållsta endpoint node with Stage 24:2 relation 9631288, but member order is not start-to-end; route drawing should use the local ordered GeoJSON/graph traversal rather than raw relation order.

Official fault section showed no reported faults during the 2026-04-27 research pass, but the same official stage text flags the Piltorp/Dalkarlstorp spring as unavailable since 2025-05. Older AllTrails blowdown reports from 2023 appear stale after later 2024/2025 good/fair condition reports.

Eskilstuna announced 2026 Vilsta friluftsområde development and traffic-safety works near Vilstavägen, including local narrowings and changed motor access; this may affect local car access/parking approaches without implying the trail is closed.

Route character is easy-to-moderate lowland hiking: Vilsta reserve paths and exercise tracks, Skjulsta/Karl IX canal side context, old mine hole, Uvberget hillfort/viewpoint, small hilly/rocky terrain toward Dalkarlstorp, Skogstorp-Stenkvista road crossing, Granstusjön, Dansberget, then easier path to Hållstavägen. Older reports mention wet, rocky, mosquito-heavy or awkward conditions around Granstusjön/Dansberget after rain.

Vilsta nature reserve rules apply near the start: fires only at designated places, no damaging trees/plants/geological features, motor vehicles only on roads/parking, riding only on marked riding trails/roads, and organized camps/competitions require consultation with Eskilstuna municipality.

Dogs must be leashed in Vilsta nature reserve and signed exercise tracks. Eskilstuna local rules also restrict dogs at municipal bathing places during the summer bathing season except designated dog bathing areas.

Ordinary one-night tenting was not found to be explicitly banned in Vilsta reserve, but do not treat the friluftsområde as a wild-camp spot. Use durable, discreet sites away from homes, crops, riding routes, facility grounds, and sensitive areas; organized group camps require consultation.

facilities.name: Vilsta stage start
facilities.description: Official 24:1 start at Vilsta friluftsområde, with local bus access from Eskilstuna and services nearby.

facilities.name: Vilsta Motionscentrum bus access
facilities.description: Nearest start-side bus context; current Sörmlandstrafiken terminal map lists line 6 to Vilsta Motionscenter. Verify live departures.

facilities.name: Vilsta parking/access

facilities.name: Vilsta toilets

facilities.name: Eskilstuna SweCamp Vilsta

facilities.name: Vilsta designated grill places

facilities.name: Eskilstuna ridhus parking access

facilities.name: Uvberget hillfort and viewpoint

facilities.name: Piltorp/Dalkarlstorp spring unavailable
facilities.description: Official spring coordinate, but Sörmlandsleden says it is not accessible as of a 2025-05 report. OSM still tags a nearby spring as drinking water; override OSM and do not rely on it until reverified.

facilities.name: Skogstorp road-crossing services
facilities.description: Off/near-route Skogstorp pizzeria and local-service context near the road crossing; verify hours and do not treat as guaranteed trail service.

facilities.name: Hållsta stage endpoint, no parking
facilities.description: Official shared 24:1 endpoint and 24:2 start near Hållstavägen. Stage 24:2 says no parking at the stage start; use bus/road-walk planning or other legal parking.

facilities.name: Åläng closer bus context
facilities.description: Closer Hållsta-side bus context west of the trail endpoint. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken; current public map shows line 19 Hållsta-Bälgviken while older official text may still say bus 9.

facilities.name: Hållsta village bus stops
facilities.description: Secondary Hållsta village bus access, farther west/northwest of the trail endpoint. Night bus 65 and line 19 context must be verified live before relying on it.

facilities.name: Hållsta village services
facilities.description: Small off-route Hållsta village service context such as pizzeria/fuel/kiosk west of the trail endpoint; do not infer toilet, tap, groceries, or trailhead service, and verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Hållsta badplats side facility
facilities.description: Off-route village bathing place in an old gravel pit with sand beach, jetty, grill place, seating, toilet and dog-bathing context. Park only where signed and do not treat lake water as drinking water.

sections.name: Stage 24:2: Hållsta to Kvarntorp
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 24:2, Hållsta to Kvarntorp.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun.

Hållsta is the official start but has no parking at the stage start. Bus access is via Hållsta/Åläng area stops west of the route; official text still mentions bus 9, while current transit references and OSM point to Sörmlandstrafiken line 19, so verify live departures before using it.

Bälgviken gives mid-stage bus and possible parking/access context, but no dependable shop, cafe, food service, or active rail service was verified; treat the former railway station as bus/access context only.

Kvarntorp is the main facility endpoint, with shelter, grill/fireplace, good tent spots, bathing, and nearby reserve parking. No toilet, bin, or reliable drinking-water point was verified at Kvarntorp. A viewpoint/rest table about 350 m north of the shelter is useful for map context but not a service point.
waterSources: No official drinking-water source is listed on stage 24:2. Carry water from Hållsta/Eskilstuna or from verified services before starting.

Lake water from Bälgvikssjön/Näshultasjön and any streams/springs should be treated as natural/untested. OSM/Vindskyddskartan-style sources mention Kvarntorp-area spring/well context, but Sörmlandsleden and reserve pages do not list it as a stage water source and hiker reports describe difficulty finding or trusting water here; treat/filter/boil and carry backup.
The nearest official sources are on stage 24:3 beyond Kvarntorp, not on this stage.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official and Naturkartan distance is 14 km. OSM relation 9631288 is tagged distance=14 km and current relation geometry measures roughly 13.2 km, while local/third-party derived tracks run about 12.7-13.0 km; use official 14 km as canonical.

Draw Stage 24:2 as a standalone continuous route from Hållsta to the Kvarntorp handoff. OSM/local topology shares nodes cleanly with 24:1 at Hållsta and 24:3 at Kvarntorp; the official shelter coordinate sits about 80-90 m from the local chain node, so keep it as an endpoint facility/short spur rather than warping the stage line. Do not merge 24:1, 24:3, Lillsundet side path, Kvarntorp shelter spur, parking connectors, or Österby seasonal services into the stage geometry.

Official current fault dated 2026-04-19 reports forestry work between Ståltorp/Stålstorp and Bälgviken, with logs and branches on the trail and machine-damaged/churned tread. Expect a slower, rougher passage and follow current markings carefully.

Route character is generally easy walking: gravel road from Hållsta, Årby younger Iron Age grave field with many mounds and a standing stone, old lime-kiln/quarry remains, conifer forest and rocky sections, road 694 crossing, Bälgviken old station/railway crossing, gravel road by Bälgvikssjön, Smalsundet/Lillsundet lake-rest context, a viewpoint/table north of the Kvarntorp shelter, and Kvarntorp reserve/Näshultasjön.

Kvarntorp is a municipal nature reserve, about 217 ha and protected since 2007. Do not damage living or dead trees/shrubs, ground, stones, or bedrock; do not collect/kill invertebrates; do not damage/pick protected flora beyond permitted berries/edible mushrooms/flowers for personal use; avoid ad hoc fires on ground or rock. Use only established fireplaces and check fire-ban status.

Kvarntorp has official good tent spots and no explicit tenting ban was found in the reserve rules. Use low-impact one-night tenting near the indicated area, respect grazing animals near Kvarntorp, keep dogs under close control/leashed around livestock, and follow posted signs.

facilities.name: Hållsta stage start, no parking

facilities.name: Hållsta / Åläng bus context
facilities.description: Closer Hållsta/Åläng-area bus access is still a road walk from the route. Official text says bus 9, while current transit references and OSM indicate line 19; verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Hållsta pizzeria and fuel context
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent Hållsta pizzeria and nearby fuel context west of the stage start. No current public kiosk/lodging claim was verified; not a trailhead service.

facilities.name: Årby grave field and lime-kiln remains
facilities.description: Approximate early-stage cultural-history context: younger Iron Age grave field with many mounds and one standing stone, plus old 19th-century limestone-kiln/quarry remains. Look but do not disturb.

facilities.name: Ståltorp-Bälgviken forestry warning
facilities.description: Current official 2026-04-19 fault: forestry work between Ståltorp/Stålstorp and Bälgviken, with logs/branches on the trail and churned-up tread.

facilities.name: Stålstorp bus/forestry warning area

facilities.name: Kvighagen tiny parking context
facilities.description: OSM-mapped tiny free parking context near the road-694/Ulriksdal area, not listed by the official trail page and likely very limited. Use only if signed/legal and do not block local access.

facilities.name: Bälgviken station/bus context
facilities.description: Mid-stage bus/parking context at the old station area. Useful bailout/access point, but no dependable food resupply or active rail service was verified.

facilities.name: Bälgviken parking context
facilities.description: Official stage text says parking is possible in Bälgviken, but no specific mapped car park was verified; follow local signs and avoid blocking residents or bus access.

facilities.name: Road 694 crossing
facilities.description: Road crossing/road-walking awareness near Bälgviken. Use extra care and follow current orange markings.

facilities.name: Bälgviken railway crossing
facilities.description: Approximate old railway/station crossing context after Lilla Bälgvikssjön. The station is disused for passenger rail, but cross tracks/road infrastructure cautiously where signed.

facilities.name: Smalsundet water pause context
facilities.description: Approximate water-side pause context around Smalsundet, the hand-dug canal between Bälgvikssjön and Näshultasjön. No toilet, tap or formal service verified.

facilities.description: Signed side-path rest context north of Lillsundet with table, fire ring and jetty reported in official/secondary descriptions; approximate pin.

facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden indicates parking at/near Kvarntorps naturreservat and Eskilstuna directions describe a first parking after the Bälgviken-Kvarntorp approach, but accessibility facts conflict; do not assume accessible, abundant, or guaranteed parking.

facilities.description: OSM-mapped spring with drinking_water=yes near Kvarntorp, but not listed by Sörmlandsleden or reserve pages as a stage water source and reported hard to rely on by hikers. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.description: Official good tent spots and bathing possibility by Näshultasjön. No toilet, tap, or bin was verified; respect reserve rules, grazing animals, and posted signs.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp viewpoint and table
facilities.description: Approximate viewpoint/rest table about 350 m north of the Kvarntorp shelter, from official maintainer tip. Useful rest context but no toilet, water, bin or fire claim.
