sections.name: Stage 56: Trosa to Tullgarns slott
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 56, Trosa to Tullgarns slott.
utilities: Official area: Södertäljes kommun, Trosa kommun.

Trosa has the strongest start services: buses, town parking, public toilets, potable town water, food, lodging, and resupply. There is no parking at the stage board itself; use town parking such as Högbergsgatan/Trosa kyrka areas and check local time limits.

Trosa tourist information, harbour services, and town lodging/food options sit close enough to the start to be useful for planning. Public toilets are available in town/harbour locations, with some year-round and some seasonal; verify current municipal status before relying on a specific toilet.

Stensund is the key mid-stage service point, with seasonal harbour tap, summer toilets, bathing, parking, grill/rest area, and folkhögskola/servering services when open. It is also a sensible bail-in/bail-out point if 20 km is too much.
Anderviken is the main on-stage shelter/rest facility after about 12 km. It has a shelter plus third-party/blog-confirmed toilet/fire/table context, but no reliable drinking water and no sea view.

Tullgarn stage endpoint is near the Tullgarn/Kungsgård stage junction; palace toilets, cafe/restaurant, parking, Orangeriet summer restaurant, and visitor services are a short detour from the exact route endpoint and are seasonal/opening-hour dependent.
waterSources: Stensund is the only dependable on-route refill, but seasonal: official guidance says the harbour tap is open from 1 May to the end of September behind the outhouse/toilet at Stensunds hamn.
Outside the Stensund tap season, water may be possible at Stensunds servering/restaurant when open, but this is not an all-hours guarantee.
Trosa has town water through public services and taps; Tullgarn has visitor services when open. Komötet and coastal water are bathing/natural water only, not potable refill points.
No reliable drinking water was verified at Anderviken shelter; carry from Stensund/Trosa or plan around Tullgarn services.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden, Naturkartan, and OSM relation 7449018 list Stage 56 as 20.0 km. Third-party tracks vary from about 19.4-22.4 km depending on access, direction, endpoint, and optional variants; use 20 km as canonical.

Stage 56 connects cleanly to Stage 55 at Trosa and to Stage 57 at Tullgarn. OSM relation 7449018 is continuous internally and measured about 19.47 km in the geometry review; the Stage 56 OSM endpoint is about 78 m from the Stage 57 start marker, a palace-area endpoint-placement mismatch rather than a real hiking gap.

Long, moderate stage with mixed urban streets, country roads, coastal paths, forest paths, rocky slabs, hilly/kuperad sections, open land, and final Tullgarn road approach. Expect slower going than a flat 20 km and be careful on wet rock slabs.

Road-walking warning: the route uses town streets, country roads, and final approach roads. Walk on pavement/shoulder where present, use the left side when forced onto the roadway, and use reflectors or a lamp in low light.

Navigation warning from official/Naturkartan and hiker sources: follow Sörmlandsleden's orange S-markings on trees/posts/arrows, not other similar orange/square/hip-height exercise-route markings in the Stensund/Tullgarn area. Older downloaded GPX/screenshots can also be slightly wrong near Tullgarn.
Stensund camping is not a normal drop-in public hiker campsite; Stensund describes camping as group/seasonal arrangements. Do not plan ordinary tent camping there without direct permission/booking.

Komötet/Komöte badplats is a day-use bathing place with toilets/changing, not a confirmed legal campsite. Older trip reports and older route/package language conflict around camping/fire here; current signs and reserve rules win.

Tullgarn/Furholmen reserve rules are stricter than general allemansrätten: dogs/pets leashed, fires only at prepared places, camping forbidden in Furholmen and the inner/original Tullgarn reserve zone, and no collecting/breaking wood in Furholmen.
Stensund reserve also has special rules protecting plants, deadwood, fungi/lichens, and invertebrate habitats; organized camps/competitions require permission.

Tullgarn transit is limited and timetable-sensitive. Trosabussen's winter timetable checked for 2025-12-15 to 2026-06-14 shows Tullgarn service only in limited/requested weekend contexts; verify same-day routing.

Official Stage 56 page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Fire-ban map checks found no general fire ban for Trosa/Södertälje at that time, but fire-risk notices are dynamic and protected-area prepared-fireplace rules still apply.

Tullgarn palace park is generally open year-round, while palace interiors/cafe/restaurant services are seasonal/opening-hour dependent. Palace visitor rules restrict pets indoors, large bags, spikes, drones, and disruptive photography.

facilities.name: Tullgarn/Furholmen reserve rules
facilities.description: Dogs/pets leashed, fires only at designated prepared places, camping forbidden in Furholmen and inner Tullgarn zones, no collecting/breaking wood in Furholmen, no motor vehicles except designated roads, no caravans/trailers set up, and riding only where allowed.

facilities.name: Tullgarn palace visitor rules
facilities.description: Park is generally year-round, but palace interior tours/services are seasonal. Indoors: pets generally not allowed except assistance dogs, large bags/strollers/spikes/drone/tripod/flash restrictions apply.

facilities.name: Tullgarn falling-spruce warning
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen notes bark-beetle-damaged spruce/falling-tree risk in Tullgarn. Be cautious in wind and avoid lingering under dead spruces.

sections.name: Stage 57: Tullgarns slott to Kasholmen, Mörkö
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 57, Tullgarns slott to Kasholmen, Mörkö.
utilities: Official area: Södertäljes kommun.

Tullgarn has start-side visitor parking, accessible toilets, cafe/shop/visitor-centre context, restaurant context, and limited timetable-dependent bus access via Tullgarns allé/Grindstugan, but food, tours, and transport are seasonal/time-sensitive.

Näset is the main on-stage service cluster: parking for about 15 cars, dry toilets, picnic/rest tables, grill/fireplace, firewood box, and accessible rest-area context. Sörmlandsleden says the toilets are maintained outside the trail association.

Kasholmen has official endpoint parking/access on the Mörkö side, but independent map data suggests a limited/informal parking/turning area rather than a large formal lot. Nearby Pålsundet stops are best treated as Mörkötrafiken/on-demand or live-planner transit access.

There is no verified shelter, shop, cafe, toilet, or drinking water at the Kasholmen endpoint itself. Idala Café & Lanthandel is a useful off-route Mörkö service farther east when open, but the endpoint itself is mainly a logistics point.
waterSources: The only verified on-stage water is the natural spring after Fornborgen, around 8 km in. Sörmlandsleden says water is usually available but not analyzed; treat/filter/boil and do not rely on it in drought.
Tullgarn visitor services may provide water when open, but this is seasonal/opening-hour dependent. No water source was verified at Kasholmen.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden lists 11.5 km, Naturkartan 11.4 km, and OSM relation 7448870 is a continuous 25-way chain measuring about 11.37 km despite a rounded 12 km tag. Use 11.5 km as the canonical stage distance.

Stage 57 connects Stage 56 at Tullgarn to Stage 58 at Kasholmen. It passes Djurgårdsparken, Tallbacken/Tullbotorp, Näset, Fornborgen, the spring north of Skyttorp, grave-field/cultural-remains context, Mörköbron, and Kasholmen. Draw all official relation members, including gravel roads, the short Stage 56 connector, Mörköbron, and the road section to Kasholmen. Keep both the official Tullgarn start marker and the OSM routable Stage 56/57 join because they differ by about 80 m.
No shelter was verified on Stage 57. Utsidan/forum checks and official facility lists agree that there is no wind shelter on this section; the next shelter context is on Stage 58 if continuing.

Tenting is forbidden between Tullgarns slott and Skyttorp. Sörmlandsleden notes suitable tent spots north of Skyttorp around the spring, but users must still obey local signs, reserve boundaries, pasture/private-ground constraints, and fire bans.

Tullgarn/Furholmen reserve rules: fires only at designated prepared places, pets/dogs leashed, camping prohibited in Furholmen and the inner Tullgarn zone, no collecting/breaking wood in Furholmen, and no landing on Furholmen April 15-June 30. Use Näset fireplace only when current fire rules allow.
Grazed pastures occur around Djurgårdsparken and Näset-Skyttorp; keep dogs leashed and move calmly around livestock. Hiker reports specifically mention curious cattle around the Näset pasture.

Mörköbron has no dedicated pedestrian walkway, OSM tags the bridge road as AB 569/maxspeed 80, and the bridge itself is about 186 m of tertiary asphalt plus road approaches. Traffic can be fast, especially around ferry timing; cross with high visibility and care, and use reflectors/lamp in low light or rain.

Cultural remains around the fornborg/grave-field areas are look-but-do-not-disturb sites. Swedish heritage rules prohibit disturbing, removing, covering, altering, or damaging protected ancient remains without permission.

Mörkötrafiken replaced older fixed Mörkö bus patterns, including line 785, on 2023-12-10. It is booked in the Mörkötrafiken SL app or via SL customer service, uses normal SL tickets/payment, and has no fixed timetable; do not rely on old 785 advice.

Official Stage 57 page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, and the wider Sörmlandsleden homepage warning found then concerned Stage 50:1, not Stage 57. A 2025 AllTrails note reported weaker Mörkö-side signage/maintenance; treat that as a local/anecdotal signal and check recent reports before hiking.

Wetness is condition-dependent rather than constant. Older reports describe flooding/wading near Häggenäs/Ängstugan and a wet low section after rain or spring melt, while later reports found good conditions; bring footwear that handles roots, rocks, and occasional wet low sections.

facilities.name: Tullgarn stage 57 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 57 start, connecting from Stage 56 toward Kasholmen/Mörkö.

facilities.name: Tullgarn visitor parking
facilities.description: Visitor parking by Tullgarn palace services, a short walk from the stage start. Check local signs and seasonal arrangements.

facilities.name: Tullgarn visitor toilets
facilities.description: Free toilets near the palace/parking service area, including wheelchair-accessible toilet context. Royal Palaces list daily hours around 09:00-16:30 Jun-Aug and 09:00-16:00 Sep-May; verify current opening.

facilities.name: Tullgarn cafe/shop
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe/shop/visitor-centre context in Drottning Victorias stall, with drinks, pastries/waffles, shop, and guided-tour ticket sales when open; verify current opening days and hours before relying on food or water.

facilities.name: Tullgarns värdshus/restaurant
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe context near Tullgarn, opening-hour and season dependent.

facilities.name: Tullgarn / Tullgarns allé limited bus access
facilities.description: Tullgarn/Tullgarns allé/Grindstugan access is limited and request/timetable dependent. Checked Trosabussen guidance says weekend/holiday Tullgarn service is by request, with riders from Liljeholmen telling the driver and only selected Trosa departures via Tullgarn; verify live routing.

facilities.name: Näset parking
facilities.description: Näset entrance/parking area with about 15 spaces reported by Naturkartan. Useful access/rest point on Stage 57.

facilities.name: Näset dry toilets
facilities.description: Dry toilets at Näset; Sörmlandsleden notes toilets here are not maintained by the trail association.

facilities.name: Näset picnic/rest area
facilities.description: Picnic/rest tables and accessible rest context at Näset.

facilities.name: Näset fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill at Näset with firewood-box context from Naturkartan/Grillplatser. Use only when fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Näsudden optional rest detour
facilities.description: Optional scenic rest/picnic context on Näsudden, off the main route. Naturkartan/secondary sources also highlight nearby Kasberget viewpoints; treat as detours, not core stage facilities.

facilities.name: Fornborgen viewpoint
facilities.description: Fornborg/high viewpoint with views toward Mörkö and Pålsundet. Approximate pin from route geometry and corroborated trip reports; cultural remains are look-but-do-not-disturb.

facilities.name: Spring after Fornborgen
facilities.description: Official natural spring after Fornborgen. Water is usually available but not analyzed; Team Vildmark saw good flow in 2019 but did not fill there. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup, especially in dry periods.

facilities.name: North of Skyttorp tenting context
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden notes suitable tent spots north of Skyttorp around the spring. This is not a formal campsite; obey signs, reserve rules, pasture/private-ground constraints, and leave no trace.

facilities.name: No tenting Tullgarn-Skyttorp
facilities.description: Camping/tenting is forbidden between Tullgarns slott and Skyttorp. Do not pitch before the north-of-Skyttorp/spring area unless current signs explicitly allow it.

facilities.name: Pasture and dog-leash warning
facilities.description: Grazed pastures around Djurgårdsparken and Näset-Skyttorp; dogs/pets must be leashed and hikers should move calmly around livestock.

facilities.name: Stage 57 wet low-section caveat
facilities.description: Older reports describe flooding/wading near Häggenäs/Ängstugan and a wet low section after rain or spring melt; later reports found good conditions. Treat as weather-dependent wetness and keep shoes/poles suitable.

facilities.name: Mörköbron road-safety warning
facilities.description: Official road/bridge section with no dedicated pedestrian walkway. OSM tags AB 569 at 80 km/h, and the bridge itself is about 186 m of tertiary asphalt plus road approaches. Traffic can be fast around Skanssundet ferry timing; use high visibility, reflectors/lamp in low light, and extra care.

facilities.name: Kasholmen stage 57/58 junction
facilities.description: Stage 57 endpoint and Stage 58 start on the Mörkö side of Mörköbron.

facilities.name: Kasholmen limited parking/access
facilities.description: Official parking/access at Kasholmen on the Mörkö side, but independent mapping suggests a limited/possibly informal turning area near the bridge rather than a large formal lot.

facilities.name: Pålsundet / Mörkötrafiken access
facilities.description: Nearby Pålsundet stop/access for Mörkötrafiken or live SL planning. Current Mörkö service is on-demand/bookable rather than a frequent fixed bus; buy a normal SL ticket separately.

facilities.name: Mörkötrafiken booking rules
facilities.description: Mörkötrafiken replaced old fixed line 785 on 2023-12-10. Book in the Mörkötrafiken SL app or via SL customer service, expect no fixed timetable and a typical wait, and use normal SL ticket/payment channels.

facilities.name: Idala Café & Lanthandel detour
facilities.description: Off-route Mörkö cafe/service-store context east of Kasholmen, useful for Stage 58 or access planning when open. Seasonal May-September; not an on-stage Stage 57 service.

facilities.name: Mörkö-side marking caveat
facilities.description: Low-confidence user-report caveat: a 2025 review described weaker Mörkö-side marking/maintenance, while official comments also report good marking. Check recent reports and keep map handy.

sections.name: Stage 58: Kasholmen, Mörkö to Skanssundet
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 58, Kasholmen, Mörkö to Skanssundet.
utilities: Official area: Södertäljes kommun.

Kasholmen/Pålsundet is the start/access node, with official parking/access and nearby Mörkötrafiken/SL stop context. Treat older fixed-bus-785 advice as stale; Mörkötrafiken is now on-demand and must be booked/planned separately.

Norafjärden is the key on-stage overnight/rest cluster after the 2023 reroute: shelter, grill/fireplace, dry toilet, and waterfront rest context. It has no verified drinking water and no confirmed sampled bathing status.

Salsudd/Åbynäs has bathing, toilet, and parking context near the northern part of the stage. Coordinates are strongest from OSM plus Sörmlandsleden's Salsudd mention; no current municipal bathing-service page was found.

Skansholmen/Skanssundet is the services-heavy finish: shop/reception, seasonal food/cafe/ice cream, camping/cabins/hostel, guest harbour, toilets/showers for guests, seasonal marked water taps, paid parking, ferry, and bus/ferry access.
waterSources: No reliable potable mid-stage water was verified. Norafjärden shelter is by brackish coastal water and should not be treated as a drinking-water source.

The only verified refill is the seasonal summer tap at Skansholmens Affär & Café/service area near the finish. Skansholmen asks visitors to be sparing with water; verify opening/season and carry enough water for the whole stage.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Use 10.5 km as the canonical official distance. Naturkartan lists 10.6 km, AllTrails about 10.1 km, Topo GPS/OSM-derived geometry about 11.2 km, and older blogs vary because some predate the 2023 reroute.

Stage 58 was rerouted in 2023 to pass the new Norafjärden shelter and toilet; the official updated map was posted 2023-04-27. Follow current orange markings and avoid older GPX/blog tracks. Naturkartan's exposed geometry appears incomplete/stale here: it measures about 8.6 km and does not pass the Norafjärden shelter area, despite the page showing a 10.6 km length.

Official information listed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. A 2024 official-page comment said stages 57-58 were well marked, while some 2025 review material still recommends using an offline map around open pasture, the shelter reroute, and clear-cut areas.

OSM relation 7448733 passes close to the Norafjärden shelter and is a better current geometry candidate than Naturkartan, but it has a mapped gap near Skansholmen/Salsudd from about 59.040191, 17.686411 to 59.041779, 17.694478. Treat this as a data-quality warning and follow current waymarks locally.

Cattle/grazing animals may be present in pastures, and an official signed alternative exists for hikers who want to avoid animals. Keep dogs leashed, give livestock space, close gates, and avoid walking between animals and young.

The northern part has clear-cuts, new spruce plantings, rockier height sections, and slippery leaves/rock after rain. Stay on the marked route through forestry areas and avoid stepping on new plantings.

For overnight planning, the Norafjärden shelter is the least ambiguous option. Outside it, apply allemansrätten cautiously: not on cultivated land or pasture, not near houses, no disturbance, and local signs/rules override assumptions.

Stage 58 connects to Stage 59 by ferry, not by a walked trail line. The Mörkö-side endpoint is at Skanssundet/Skansholmen, while Stage 59 starts on the Hörningsnäs side after the free Skanssundsleden ferry.

Skanssundet access depends on the free 330 m Trafikverket road ferry and current bus/Mörkötrafiken arrangements. Trafikverket's page may show stale disruption notices such as old June 2025 closures, so check live ferry/SL/Mörkötrafiken status before committing to public-transport logistics.

Skanssundet and Nora Holmäng have nearby Natura 2000 shore-meadow/grassland context. Stay on marked trail/roads, avoid disturbing birds/livestock, and do not camp, light fires, collect plants, or trample sensitive shore habitat.

facilities.name: Kasholmen stage 58 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 58 start and Stage 57 junction on the Mörkö side of Mörköbron.

facilities.name: Kasholmen parking/access
facilities.description: Official parking/access at the stage start. Independent mapping suggests treating it as limited rather than a large formal lot.

facilities.name: Pålsundet / Mörkötrafiken access
facilities.description: Nearby Pålsundet stop/access context for bookable Mörkötrafiken/SL. Mörkötrafiken replaced old fixed line 785 and has no fixed timetable; book in the app or via SL customer service and verify live planning.

facilities.name: Kasholmsberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint/bird-migration and cultural-remains context near the start. Approximate pin from official route description and local topography.

facilities.name: Stage 58 2023 reroute
facilities.description: Official route was rerouted in 2023 to pass the new shelter/toilet area; the updated official map was posted 2023-04-27. Follow current orange markings and avoid older pre-2023 tracks. Naturkartan's exposed line appears incomplete/stale for this reroute.

facilities.name: Norafjärden shelter
facilities.description: New Stage 58 shelter by Norafjärden after the 2023 reroute. Coordinates are high-confidence from official comments/OSM and the current OSM relation passes close to the shelter; Vindskyddskartan plots a nearby but less preferred point.

facilities.name: Norafjärden fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Shelter-area grill/fireplace. Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance says firewood is not supplied; use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Norafjärden dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near the Norafjärden shelter, mapped separately in OSM and corroborated by official shelter notes.

facilities.name: Norafjärden brackish water
facilities.description: Water beside the shelter is brackish coastal water, not a verified drinking source, and no sampled bathing-water page was found. Carry water or refill at Skansholmen when open.

facilities.name: Pasture/cattle alternative route
facilities.description: Stage passes grazing animals in pasture. Official material notes a signed alternative route for hikers who want to avoid animal contact. Keep dogs leashed, close gates, and give livestock space.

facilities.name: Clear-cut and new spruce warning
facilities.description: Northern section includes clear-cut/forestry areas, rockier height sections, and new spruce plantings. Stay on the marked trail and protect young plantings; use current map/markers through the 2023 reroute area.

facilities.name: Salsudd / Åbynäs bathing place
facilities.description: Bathing-place context around Salsudd/Åbynäs mentioned by Sörmlandsleden and mapped in OSM. No current municipal sampled-bathing/service page was verified, so check local signs.

facilities.name: Salsudd / Åbynäs toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet building near the Salsudd/Åbynäs bathing area. Service level/season was not confirmed by a municipal page.

facilities.name: Salsudd / Åbynäs parking
facilities.description: Parking/access context for the Salsudd/Åbynäs bathing area. Official stage lists Salsudd parking; OSM maps nearby surface parking around Åbynäs/Hölö båtklubb.

facilities.name: Stage 58 mapped route gap
facilities.description: OSM Stage 58 relation has a roughly 494 m topological gap near Skansholmen/Salsudd, and Naturkartan's exposed geometry stops before the ferry/cafe area. Do not infer a straight connector; follow current orange markings on site.

facilities.name: Skansholmen services
facilities.description: Shop/reception, seasonal food/cafe/ice cream, restaurant/bistro, camping, cabins/hostel, guest harbour, toilets/showers for guests, waste room, guest kitchen, sauna/laundry hire, and other services. Verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Skansholmen camping/lodging
facilities.description: Commercial camping, tent/camper pitches, cabins, hostel, and guest-harbour lodging context at the stage finish. Guests have access to service-house toilets/showers; book/check season before relying on it.

facilities.name: Skansholmen summer tap
facilities.description: Seasonal water tap by Skansholmens Affär & Café/service area. Skansholmen marks water points but asks visitors to be sparing and limits larger fills; verify season/opening.

facilities.name: Skansholmen parking
facilities.description: Parking near Skansholmen/Skanssundet. Skansholmen reports paid parking about 150 m from the facility, listed at 15 kr/hour or 180 kr/day in the checked source.

facilities.name: Skanssundet ferry, Mörkö side
facilities.description: Free Trafikverket road ferry across Skanssundet to Hörningsnäs/Södertörn, about 330 m and 3 minutes. Check live status because old disruption notices may remain visible on source pages.

facilities.name: Skanssundet bus/Mörkötrafiken access
facilities.description: Mörkö-side on-demand access near the finish. Use live SL/Mörkötrafiken planning; old fixed line 785 references are stale after the permanent demand-responsive service.

facilities.name: Skanssundet ferry, Hörningsnäs side
facilities.description: North-side ferry terminal with bus 727 connection toward Tumba/Stockholm according to Skansholmen directions.

facilities.name: Skanssundet bus 727 stop
facilities.description: Fixed SL bus 727 access on the Hörningsnäs side after taking the ferry; useful for Tumba/Stockholm connections. Verify current departures in SL.

facilities.name: Nora Holmäng shore-meadow caution
facilities.description: Nearby/start-side Natura 2000 shore-meadow and grassland context. It is private/pasture-dominated land with sensitive shore birds and meadow flora; stay on the marked route and avoid disturbance.

facilities.name: Skanssundet shore-meadow caution
facilities.description: Natura 2000 shore-meadow context near Skanssundet, protecting Baltic coastal meadows and species-rich grasslands. Stay on marked trail/roads and avoid camping, fires, bird disturbance, plant collecting, or trampling sensitive shore habitat.

sections.name: Stage 59: Skanssundet to Viad
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 59, Skanssundet to Viad.
utilities: Official area: Botkyrka kommun.
Skanssundet/Hörningsnäs is the dependable stage-start access cluster: official trailhead, ferry terminal, parking, SL 727 stop, and mapped public dry/portable toilets with no drinking water.

Sandviksbadet is the main early alternate/access cluster: official route variant, EU bathing beach, seasonal toilet, kiosk in bathing weather, grill/barbecue context, signed bath parking, and SL 727 stops near the road.

Hörningsnäs naturreservat/Lundstigen provides an 800 m yellow-marked local alternative to part of the gravel-road section, with information boards, small reserve access/parking, picnic/viewpoint context, and no verified water.
Viad is a trail junction rather than a service node. Stage 60 explicitly says no parking at Viad; plan pickup, continue to Stage 60, or walk out toward Näs/Eldtomta bus access.
Skansholmen services and the Skansholmen water tap are across/near the Stage 58 ferry side, useful for chained hikes but not reliable as Stage 59 on-route services.
Eldtomta has useful off-route finish-side services by bus 727: cafe, lodging, and a 24/7 food vending machine. Treat them as detour or access planning, not on-stage facilities.
waterSources: No verified potable water was found on Stage 59. Carry enough from Skansholmen/Skanssundet-side services or earlier.
Skanssundet toilets are mapped with no drinking water, Sandviksbadet has seasonal toilets/kiosk but no verified trail water tap, and coastal/brackish water should not be treated as a refill plan.
If continuing, Stage 60 has natural sources and Stora Träsket shelter after Viad, but those are beyond Stage 59 and still require treatment/filtering.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Use 9.0 km as the official planning distance. Naturkartan/Komoot-style mainline geometry measures about 9.1 km, while OSM relation 5280050 can measure about 9.45 km when the ferry is included and its metadata rounds to 10 km.

Stage 59 starts on the Hörningsnäs/Södertörn side of Skanssundet. OSM relation 5280050 includes the Skanssundet ferry from the Mörkö side for through-route continuity, but official Stage 59 should treat that ferry as an inter-stage connector rather than walked land-stage distance.
Official information listed no current Stage 59 fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Use live Trafikverket ferry info and SL/727 planning before relying on access logistics.

The first roughly 3 km include larger/smaller road and gravel-road walking. Komoot's surface breakdown is mostly road/asphalt/gravel, and user reports plus Team Vildmark recommend considering the Sandviksbadet alternate and Lundstigen for a nicer start.

Cattle/grazing animals may be present between Näs By and Viad, including along the waterline and around gates. Keep dogs leashed, move calmly around livestock, avoid crowding animals at gates, and expect wet or awkward shoreline/pasture footing.
No official Stage 59 shelter, campsite, fireplace, toilet, or water facility was verified. Treat AllTrails camping/dog-friendly tags as generic activity metadata, not site-specific permissions.

Hörningsnäs reserve rules include no fire except at designated places, parking only in designated places, no caravans, no plant/wood removal, riding only on constructed road, and dogs leashed. Lundstigen is short and useful but not fully accessible, and no designated Stage 59 fire site was verified.

Sandviksbadet/Himmerfjärden-Sandviken is an EU bathing site with 2026 classification Bra kvalitet and a 15 May-15 September bathing season. Check live samples and algae warnings before swimming; 2026 sample dates are listed for June 9, July 7, July 21, and August 4.
The Sandviksbadet alternate is official but appears to be missing from OSM Stage 59 relation 5280050. Mainline-only imports underrepresent the official route options.

AllTrails/user reports warn that some third-party tracks may overshoot Viad or miss the Sandviksbadet alternate. Prefer official/Naturkartan/Sörmlandsleden geometry for the stage endpoint, and avoid using the implausibly high Topo GPS ascent figure.

facilities.name: Skanssundet stage 59 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 59 start on the Hörningsnäs/Södertörn side, after the Skanssundet ferry connection from Stage 58.

facilities.name: Skanssundet ferry, Hörningsnäs side
facilities.description: Free Trafikverket road ferry to Mörkö/Skansholmen, about 330 m and 3 minutes. Pedestrians/cyclists board with vehicle traffic, so use the marked pedestrian area/gate and check live ferry status before relying on it.

facilities.name: Skanssundet SL 727 stop
facilities.description: SL 727 stop/terminus near the stage start. The 2026 PDF is valid to 18 June and again from 17 August, with a summer gap requiring SL live planning; regular bikes/e-scooters generally are not accepted unless folded.

facilities.name: Skanssundet parking
facilities.description: Parking near the ferry/trailhead. Official Stage 59 lists parking nearby at the Skanssundet end.

facilities.name: Skanssundet public toilets
facilities.description: Mapped dry/portable public toilets beside the ferry/parking area. OSM tags indicate no drinking water/handwashing; verify condition seasonally.

facilities.name: Ferry/live-planning warning
facilities.description: Skanssundsleden is adjacent planning infrastructure for chained hikes. OSM Stage 59 relation includes the ferry, but the official stage starts on the Hörningsnäs side; ignore stale old closure notices unless Trafikverket's live page/app confirms a current disruption.

facilities.name: OSM ferry connector caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 5280050 includes the 330 m Skanssundet ferry from Mörkö, while the official Stage 59 start is on the north/Hörningsnäs side. Show this as a connector, not walked trail distance.

facilities.name: Early road-walking caution
facilities.description: The first roughly 3 km include road/asphalt/gravel walking with ferry-traffic pulses and rural sightlines. Walk on the left edge where appropriate, use visibility in low light, and take extra care around bends.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet alternate route
facilities.description: Official early alternate route passes Sandviksbadet, and the stage manager recommends it for a swim/rest. OSM relation 5280050 and some third-party maps miss this option; follow current markings if choosing it.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet
facilities.description: EU bathing place at Himmerfjärden/Sandviken with about 150 m sandy brackish beach, toilet, grill places, and seasonal kiosk. 2026 classification is Bra kvalitet; check live samples and avoid swimming during algal blooms.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet toilet
facilities.description: Seasonal toilet at/near Sandviksbadet bathing place during the 15 May-15 September bathing season. Kiosk/toilet service can depend on bathing weather and late-season weekends; no verified drinking-water tap was found for hikers.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet kiosk
facilities.description: Seasonal kiosk by Sandviksbadet, usually tied to bathing weather/season and reduced late-summer availability. Do not rely on it without checking current opening.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet parking
facilities.description: Signed bathing-place parking for Sandviksbadet; use only marked parking and local signs.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet SL 727 stop
facilities.description: SL 727 stop near the road for Sandviksbadet/start-side access.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs SL 727 stop
facilities.description: SL 727 stop that can be used to skip some early asphalt/gravel-road walking, according to recent trail-page comments.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs / Lundstigen
facilities.description: Hörningsnäs nature-reserve access and yellow-marked Lundstigen, an 800 m leafy local alternative to part of the gravel-road section through hazel, aspen, old elm, oak woodland, rock outcrops, and field/Näslandsfjärden views. Not fully accessible; no verified water.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs picnic/viewpoint
facilities.description: Picnic table/viewpoint context in Hörningsnäs naturreservat near Lundstigen. Rest/view only; no water or toilet verified.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs reserve parking
facilities.description: Small designated reserve parking for Hörningsnäs/Lundstigen access. Reserve rules require parking only at designated places.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules include fires only at designated places, parking only in designated places, no caravans, no plant/wood removal, riding only on constructed road, and dogs leashed.

facilities.name: Näs SL 727 road access
facilities.description: Off-route/road-access bus stop on the finish half of the stage. Useful as a bailout but not directly at the trail endpoint.

facilities.name: Höglundsåsen viewpoint
facilities.description: Recommended official rest/viewpoint area above Sjövik with views toward Södertälje, Hallsfjärden, Brandalsunds slott and Viads gård. Approximate pin from route/review cross-checks.

facilities.name: Näs By to Viad pasture warning
facilities.description: Trail follows pasture/shoreline terrain where grazing animals may be present, sometimes right by the waterline. Keep dogs leashed, avoid crowding animals at gates, and expect wet/narrow or awkward footing.

facilities.name: Viad stage 59/60 junction
facilities.description: Stage 59 endpoint and Stage 60 start. Treat as a trail junction rather than a service node.

facilities.name: No reliable Viad parking
facilities.description: Stage 60 explicitly says no parking at Viad, and user reports note difficulty finding parking. Plan pickup, continue to Stage 60, or walk out toward Näs/Eldtomta transit.

facilities.name: Viad track-overshoot caveat
facilities.description: Some third-party Stage 59 tracks/reviews overshoot Viad by more than a kilometre or miss the Sandviksbadet alternate. Snap the endpoint to the official Stage 60 start coordinate here when building routes.

facilities.name: Viad beach, Stage 60 context
facilities.description: Small beach immediately after the Stage 60 start. Nearby context for hikers continuing beyond Stage 59; not a Stage 59 service guarantee.

facilities.name: Eldtomta SL 727 access
facilities.description: Practical finish-side bus access after an extra road walk from Viad. Trail comments describe the walkout as long/dull.

facilities.name: Eldtomta Café detour
facilities.description: Off-route finish-side cafe and crafts stop by bus 727. Opening hours vary; useful for access planning, not an on-stage service.

facilities.name: Eldtomta lodging detour
facilities.description: Off-route guest-house/apartment lodging near Eldtomta bus access. Verify availability before planning around it.

facilities.name: Eldtomta 24foodomat
facilities.description: OSM-mapped 24/7 grocery vending machine near Eldtomta bus access. Treat as off-route resupply and verify locally.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket shelter, Stage 60 context
facilities.description: Nearest proper onward shelter after Viad if continuing onto Stage 60. Included as continuation context, not a Stage 59 facility.

sections.name: Stage 60: Viad to Berga vägskäl
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 60, Viad to Berga vägskäl.
utilities: Official area: Botkyrka kommun, Stockholm.
Viad is the stage start/trail junction, but official Stage 60 says no parking there. Treat it as an awkward access point unless you are chaining from Stage 59 or have a pickup.

On-route facilities are concentrated around Stora Träsket: a small shelter, fireplace/grill, small jetty/rest context, reserve information, and nearby natural springs. No toilet was verified on the stage.
Myrudden is a second shelter/fireplace context just beyond the Stora Träsket shelter, likely matching the official mention of a scout-built shelter a little farther along.
Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen is the useful endpoint access node with SL 727 bus service toward Tumba/Skanssundet and limited/uncertain roadside parking context from Stage 61.

Brandalsund has nearby/off-route Viad-side reserve facilities: fireplaces, toilets, accessible parking, beach/rest context, and picnic/grill places. These are useful access/rest context within about 2 km, but not on-stage Stage 60 services.
Eldtomta and Klockargårdens Våffleri/Grödinge services are plausible off-route detour context near the eastern side, but not Stage 60 on-route services.
waterSources: Stage 60 has three official natural springs: near Stora Träsket after about 2 km, near Hallsveden/Myrudden after about 3.5 km, and near the Berga side after about 6-6.5 km. Use the coordinates rather than the inconsistent official distance wording.
All springs should be treated/filtered/boiled. Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee quantity/quality, and lake or wetland water around Stora Träsket is not a dependable refill plan.
Viad beach and Stora Träsket jetty/bathing context are unsampled natural waters in the sources checked; do not show EU bathing-water quality status for them.
No potable tap was verified on Stage 60, and no toilets were verified at the shelter, reserve, or endpoint.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Use 7.5 km as the canonical official distance. Current OSM/Naturkartan geometry measures about 7.3 km, AllTrails appears short at about 6.9 km, OSM relation metadata rounds to 8 km, and the old OSM wiki 10 km value is stale.

Stage 60 runs from Viad along a stony Hallsfjärden shoreline section, then through Hallsveden/Stora Träsket forest and wetlands, past Bondberga/Kattkulla grave-field context, and out to Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen.

Official information listed no current Stage 60 fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but 2025 reviews mention worn boardwalks/footbridges, possible unclear/new-looking alignment near the Berga end when walking backward, and AllTrails being too short near the Viad start. Prefer current orange markings and OSM/Naturkartan relation 5279829 geometry.

A March 2026 local report described a roughly 200 x 300 m forestry/nature-care area in Stora Träsket, a damaged Sörmlandsleden sign, and planned path restoration over 1-3 years. Expect disturbed ground, changed sightlines, debris, or rougher navigation locally.

Stora Träsket reserve rules: fires only at designated places, dogs leashed, do not remove dead wood or damage vegetation, and camping/tenting is allowed for no more than two consecutive nights. Avoid shoreline trampling, floating mats, boggy wetland edges, spring-fed slopes, and off-trail wetland shortcuts.
Do not rely on firewood. Naturkartan says to bring your own charcoal/wood; Vindskyddskartan's older firewood note is stale enough that users should still carry fuel or plan no fire.
No Stage 60 toilet, shop, cafe, lodging, bin, or staffed facility was verified. Carry out trash and plan water/toilet needs before starting.

Viad start parking remains unresolved: official Stage 60 says no parking, while Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan mention small reserve-access parking near Viads gård about 1 km from the reserve and the reserve plan describes only about four spaces. Treat it as limited/local reserve parking, not a reliable stage trailhead.

SL 727 is the practical access backbone, but the 2026 PDF has a summer validity gap and weekend service can be sparse. Use SL live planning and warn bikepackers that regular bikes/e-scooters generally cannot be taken on buses unless folded within SL limits.

facilities.name: Viad stage 60 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 60 start and Stage 59 endpoint by Hallsfjärden. No official parking at this stage start.

facilities.name: No official Viad parking
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden explicitly lists no parking for Stage 60. Nearby reserve-access parking is separate, limited, and not a reliable stage trailhead.

facilities.name: Viad beach
facilities.description: Informal beach/swimming context immediately after the start, followed by a stony Hallsfjärden shoreline path. Not a registered sampled bathing site in the checked HaV/Botkyrka sources; water can deepen suddenly.

facilities.name: Brandalsund south fireplace
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route Brandalsund reserve fireplace with grill, table/benches and woodshed context. Södertälje also lists beach, grill and accessible picnic/rest context in Brandalsund. Useful access/rest option near the Viad side, not an on-stage Stage 60 facility.

facilities.name: Brandalsund south toilet
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route toilet context by Brandalsund south reserve area; Södertälje confirms toilets in the Brandalsund accessibility material. Do not count as an on-stage Stage 60 toilet.

facilities.name: Brandalsund south parking
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route reserve parking for Brandalsund south area, around 450 m from the fireplace. Separate from Stage 60, whose official page says no parking at Viad.

facilities.name: Hallsfjärden stony shore
facilities.description: First section follows a stony shoreline path before turning inland. Expect uneven footing and possible wet/slippery terrain.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket west spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 2 km, west/near Stora Träsket. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup; Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee flow/quality.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter by Stora Träsket, corroborated by OSM/Vindskyddskartan. Small shared shelter, roughly four sleeping places in shelter-map data; cannot be booked.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket fireplace
facilities.description: Designated fireplace/grill at the Stora Träsket shelter. Fires only when current rules allow and only at designated sites; bring your own wood/charcoal and do not remove dead wood in the reserve.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket jetty
facilities.description: Small jetty/brygga by the shelter and lake, mentioned in official and mapped sources. Treat bathing here as unsampled natural lake water.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket reserve rules
facilities.description: Nature reserve: fires only at designated places, dogs leashed, do not take dead wood/damage vegetation, and camping no more than two consecutive nights. Berry, flower and edible mushroom picking is allowed; do not remove wood-decay fungi.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket wetland sensitivity
facilities.description: Sensitive shallow forest lake, high-humidity forest and wetland/bog-edge environment with spring-fed slopes. Stay on marked paths/boardwalks, avoid trampling shoreline mats, and do not wash or disturb hydrology in lake/spring zones.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket forestry/signage warning
facilities.description: March 2026 local reporting described a roughly 200 x 300 m forestry/nature-care area, a damaged Sörmlandsleden sign, and planned path restoration over 1-3 years. Expect disturbed ground, debris, or changed sightlines.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket information board
facilities.description: Reserve information board near the Stora Träsket trail area.

facilities.name: Myrudden shelter
facilities.description: Second lean-to shelter/fireplace context, likely the scout-built shelter mentioned by the official stage text. Verify exact availability on site.

facilities.name: Hallsveden / Myrudden spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 3.5 km near the Myrudden/Hallsveden area. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup; Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee flow/quality.

facilities.name: Boardwalk/alignment caveat
facilities.description: 2025 user reports mention renovation-needing boardwalks/footbridges around wet Stora Träsket sections, AllTrails being short near Viad, and possible unclear/new-looking alignment near Berga when walked backward. Follow current orange markings and report issues.

facilities.name: Viads gård reserve-access parking
facilities.description: Very small/limited reserve-access parking north of the stable at Viads gård, about 1 km from the reserve; the reserve plan describes only about four spaces. Not official Stage 60 trailhead parking.

facilities.name: Bondberga/Kattkulla grave field
facilities.description: Cultural-remains context: official text says the route passes one of the Stockholm area's largest grave fields and a Bronze Age cairn. Look, do not disturb.

facilities.name: Berga-side spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring listed after about 6 km in the facility strip and about 6.5 km in the text before Berga vägskäl. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Stage 60 stale map-distance caveat
facilities.description: Current OSM/Naturkartan geometry is continuous at about 7.3 km and official distance is 7.5 km. Do not inherit the stale OSM wiki 10 km value or AllTrails' likely short 6.9 km line.

facilities.name: Berga vägskäl stage 60/61 junction
facilities.description: Stage 60 endpoint and Stage 61 start at Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen. OSM relation 5279829 connects cleanly to the Stage 61 start node within about 20 m; do not trim the final Bergavägen leg.

facilities.name: Bergavägen / Berga vägskäl bus 727
facilities.description: SL bus 727 access toward Tumba/Skanssundet, with stops roughly 10-15 m from the stage endpoint. The mapped stop is Bergavägen rather than literally Berga vägskäl; check SL live departures and stop names.

facilities.name: Berga limited roadside parking
facilities.description: Stage 61 says parking may be possible along a small road near the start. Treat as limited/uncertain roadside parking, not a formal lot.

facilities.name: Klockargårdens Våffleri detour
facilities.description: Possible cafe detour near Grödinge/Berga side; check opening hours and route before relying on it.

sections.name: Stage 61: Berga vägskäl to Kvarnsjön
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 61, Berga vägskäl to Kvarnsjön.
utilities: Official area: Botkyrka kommun.
Berga vägskäl/Bergavägen is the practical start access node: SL 727 bus stops are beside the stage junction, and official parking is limited to possible roadside parking along a smaller road.
Stage 61 has no verified on-stage toilets, potable water, shelter, fireplace, campsite, formal rest area, or dependable viewpoint. Treat it as a dry, short connector stage.

A blue-marked side path/old church-walking route connects toward Grödinge kyrka, SL 727, Klockargårdens Våffleri, church/cafe parking context, and other off-route services. It is official but not reliably encoded as a separate OSM hiking relation.

Nearby detour services include Karshamra Mat & Trädgård close to the blue-connector corridor, and farther Vårsta/Botkyrka GK options for bus, groceries, toilets or food. Mark these as detours, not stage services.

Kvarnsjön is the Stage 61 endpoint and Stage 62 start, but official Stage 62 notes no parking at the start and only possible nearby roadside pockets. There is no direct confirmed endpoint transit stop.
Korsnäs, Smällan, and Grödinge kyrka are useful access options near the Kvarnsjön/Grödinge side, but require extra walking and should be planned with live SL times.
waterSources: No official drinking-water source was verified on Stage 61. Carry all water.

Kvarnsjön by Grödinge kyrka and streams/wetlands are natural surface water only; use only in an emergency after treatment/boiling and avoid relying on them in warm periods or after algae/bacteria warnings.
The first official Stage 62 source north of Axsjön is beyond Stage 61 and had a June 2025 dry/near-dry user report, so it should not be treated as a Stage 61 backup.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Use 5.5 km as the official rounded distance and about 5.37-5.4 km as the geometry/Naturkartan distance. The difference is rounding, not a route conflict.

Official information listed no current Stage 61 fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Recent comments generally describe good marking, though opinions vary sharply on whether the section feels monotonous or pleasant.

Stage 61 is a short forest/cultural-history connector from Berga vägskäl to Kvarnsjön, with Åvinge/Grödinge cultural landscape context, old roads/farm landscape, protected ancient-remains context, and a blue connector toward Grödinge kyrka.
Do not infer shelter, toilet, fireplace, rest area, or water from adjacent stages. Stage 60 and Stage 62 have facilities, but Stage 61 itself does not.

Camping is legally possible only under normal allemansrätten conditions where suitable, but this stage is a poor camping target because it is short and passes settled/cultural/private landscape near Grödinge, Åvinge and Kvarnsjön. Avoid yards, crop land, grazing animals, paths, church/village edges, ancient remains, and lake-shore pressure points.

No established Stage 61 fireplace was verified. Avoid casual fires, use a stove cautiously, and check current fire bans; a blog report described extinguishing an unsafe spreading fire placed in the middle of this stage's trail.

Stage 61 itself does not appear to cross a protected area, but Åvinge naturreservat is a nearby/off-route detour east of the trail and Grödingeleden passes outside the reserve boundary. If detouring there: no fires, dogs leashed, and do not damage or remove ground, plants, trees, dead wood, fungi, lichens, insects, or wildlife.

Kvarnsjön by Grödinge kyrka is used locally for bathing/fishing and has good public access, but it is not listed as a monitored HaV bathing site in the checked sources. Do not show official bathing-water quality status or unrestricted fishing; municipal fishing rights and local restrictions matter.

Road safety matters around Berga/Kvarnsjön/Grödinge access. Stage 62 warns that the road option from Grödinge kyrka follows a narrow 70-road without sidewalk; prefer the gravel-road/blue-marked connector where possible.
Dogs need extra strict control from 1 March to 20 August and should be leashed around farms, livestock, wildlife, and any Åvinge reserve detour.

facilities.name: Berga vägskäl stage 61 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 61 start and Stage 60/61 junction.

facilities.name: Bergavägen bus 727
facilities.description: SL 727 bus stop beside the stage start. Service can be sparse; check SL live departures.

facilities.name: Berga limited roadside parking
facilities.description: Official Stage 61 says parking may be possible along a smaller road at the beginning. Treat as limited roadside parking, not a formal lot.

facilities.name: Berga/road-walk caution
facilities.description: Early access/road sections around Berga use or approach roads with higher-speed traffic. Use care around bends and road margins.

facilities.name: Tyskbotten bus 727
facilities.description: Nearby SL 727 stop shortly after the stage start, useful for access/bailout checks. Verify current stop/service in SL.

facilities.name: Marieberg bus 727
facilities.description: Nearby SL 727 stop around the middle access corridor. Useful as a bailout/access option but not an official trailhead.

facilities.name: Snäckstaviksbäcken wet area
facilities.description: Stream/wetland context from map and blog sources. Expect mud or wet footing after rain.

facilities.name: Åvinge cultural landscape
facilities.description: Official stage text notes the route comes near Åvinge gård with roots from the 1100s. Approximate cultural-landscape pin, not a facility.

facilities.name: Åvinge reserve detour rules
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route Åvinge naturreservat: no fires, dogs leashed, and do not damage or remove ground, plants, trees, dead wood, fungi, lichens, insects, or wildlife. Not on the official Stage 61 line.

facilities.name: Blue connector to Grödinge kyrka
facilities.description: Official blue-marked old church-walking connector toward Grödinge kyrka, bus 727, and off-route services. No dedicated OSM route relation or blue trailblazing tags were found, so connector geometry is inferred and should be treated as approximate.

facilities.name: Grödinge kyrka
facilities.description: Medieval church/cultural site reached by the blue connector. Oldest parts date from the 1100s; opening varies.

facilities.name: Grödinge kyrka bus 727
facilities.description: SL 727 bus stop at Grödinge kyrka, useful for access or bailout via the blue connector. Use live SL planning because the 2026 PDF has a summer timetable gap.

facilities.name: Grödinge kyrka visitor parking
facilities.description: Church/cafe visitor parking context near the blue connector. Some mapped notes indicate visitor/customer use rather than hiking or overnight parking; obey signs.

facilities.name: Klockargårdens Våffleri
facilities.description: Cafe beside Grödinge kyrka and bus access. Verify current opening hours before relying on food or toilets.

facilities.name: Karshamra Mat & Trädgård detour
facilities.description: Off-route seasonal food/garden detour mentioned in 2025 trail comments and mapped locally. Verify opening and route before relying on it.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön stage 61/62 junction
facilities.description: Stage 61 endpoint and Stage 62 start. No formal parking or direct confirmed transit at the exact junction; use Grödinge kyrka/blue connector or other road access with care.

facilities.name: No formal Kvarnsjön parking
facilities.description: Stage 62 notes no parking at the start, though a roadside pocket may be possible nearby. Do not treat this as a formal lot.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön natural water only
facilities.description: Kvarnsjön by Grödinge kyrka is lake/surface water only; not a drinking-water facility and not listed as a monitored HaV bathing site in checked sources. Treat/boil in emergency, avoid soap/toileting near the shore, and check municipal fishing rights before fishing.

facilities.name: Korsnäs bus 727 access
facilities.description: Approximate SL 727 access near the Kvarnsjön side, requiring extra walking. Not confirmed as official stage access.

facilities.name: Smällan bus access
facilities.description: Potential eastern access beyond Kvarnsjön with mapped SL route references including 727/729/783. Requires extra road walking and live SL verification; not an official stage endpoint.

facilities.name: Grödinge cultural landscape
facilities.description: The Grödinge/Kvarnsjön/Åvinge landscape has old roads, church/farm environments, and legally protected ancient-remains context. Stay on trail/roads, avoid fields/yards, and do not disturb remains or farm operations.

facilities.name: Stage 61 fire caution
facilities.description: No established Stage 61 fireplace was verified. A hiker report described extinguishing a spreading fire placed in the middle of the trail; do not make casual fires, use a stove carefully, and check current fire status.

facilities.name: Vårsta centrum detour
facilities.description: Farther off-route service cluster with ICA and bus hub. Useful for deliberate resupply/access planning, not a Stage 61 on-route service.

facilities.name: Botkyrka GK detour
facilities.description: Off-route golf-club restaurant/toilet/water context, seasonal/opening dependent. Verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: No Stage 61 services
facilities.description: No verified on-stage shelter, toilet, fireplace, campsite, formal rest area, viewpoint, or potable water. Carry water and plan facilities from adjacent stages or off-route services.

sections.name: Stage 62: Kvarnsjön to Svarvaretorp, etapp 7
sections.description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 62, Kvarnsjön to Svarvaretorp, etapp 7.
utilities: Official area: Botkyrka kommun, Stockholm.

Kvarnsjön start has no formal trail parking or direct all-hours service. Practical access is via Grödinge kyrka/SL 727 and the blue connector; check SL because bus service can be sparse and the direct 70 km/h road option has no sidewalk.

Rosenhill cafe/kiosk and bus access sit about 1 km south of the trail after the Nynäshamnsvägen crossing, but the road approach is narrow and traffic-heavy. Treat Rosenhill as a deliberate detour, not a core trail facility.

The core stage service points are sparse: unreliable Axsjön/Axaren spring, Getaren shelter/fireplace, bird-bay boardwalk/hide, and Svarvaretorp access/parking. Toilets, tap water, restaurant, bus, larger parking, tenting, and managed outdoor-center services are at Lida after continuing on Stage 7.
waterSources: Axsjön/Axaren spring north of Axsjön is the official natural water source, but June/July 2025 hiker reports said it was almost dry, dry, or overgrown. Treat/filter/boil and carry enough water to finish without it.
Getaren lake water is emergency natural water only; no potable tap was verified at the shelter. Treat/filter and avoid relying on lake water during algal bloom or poor-water periods.
Lida friluftsgård has reliable service water/tap context after the stage via the Stage 7 continuation, including water by Lida Gym/Naturport/tent-meadow areas; Rosenhill may sell drinks when open.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Stage 62 is Kvarnsjön to Svarvaretorp, 7.7 km. Current OSM/Naturkartan geometry measures about 7.43-7.44 km, OSM metadata under-rounds to 7 km, AllTrails is close at 7.6 km, and noisy TopoGPS tracks can reach 8 km or more. Use the official catalog distance and corrected east/northeast geometry toward Getaren/Svarvaretorp.

The stage runs Kvarnsjön, Husby/Husby Hammare, Nynäshamnsvägen/Rosenhill detour area, horse-pasture bypass, Axsjön spring, Nolinge, the Norrgaviken/Getaren route choice, Getaren shelter, bird-bay boardwalk/hide, and Svarvaretorp/Stage 7 junction.

At the Norrgaviken/Getaren split, the official text and local reports recommend the south/right lakeside option for shelter, views, Jungfruberget/Norrgaviken scenery, and more varied terrain; the north/left option is shorter/direct and should be modeled as an alternate variant if available.

The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but 2025 hiker comments/reviews described overgrown or hard-to-see tread, muddy stretches, clear-cut/bare areas, and the Axsjön source as almost dry or dry/overgrown.

Road safety matters around the Grödinge church access road and Nynäshamnsvägen/Rosenhill detour. Avoid the 70 km/h no-sidewalk road option where the gravel-road/blue connector is available, and use care near crossings.
A horse pasture after the road crossing has a signed bypass. Follow the bypass when needed and keep dogs controlled; national dog supervision rules are stricter from 1 March to 20 August.

Norrga/Lida reserve and outdoor-area rules apply near Getaren/Lida. Do not damage rock/soil, remove living or dead wood, harm plants/mosses/lichens/fungi, or take wood-decay fungi; avoid dead-spruce areas in wind and keep fires to prepared places when fires are allowed.
Getaren has eutrophication pressure and Norrgaån is ecologically sensitive. Avoid washing, soap, dishwater, or waste in the lake/streams.

Getaren shelter is free, shared, first-come, and has no guaranteed firewood or trash service. Shelter-map data lists about six sleeping places, but availability is first-come. Lida's managed tent meadow/bookable lodging is the cleaner overnight plan when open/allowed.

Around Lida many tracks intersect, some local trails have ongoing access limits, and Äventyrsstigen is closed until further notice because it crosses private business/agricultural land. Follow S-marked/Sörmlandsleden arrows carefully and check the last SL bus before committing to an evening finish.

Do not naively import Sörmlandsleden's bundled full-network GPX as a single Stage 62 route: it splits the Stage 62 branch choice and Stage 7/Lida continuation into separate unnamed segments that can create false gaps, duplicated variants, or a wrong endpoint.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön stage 62 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 62 start and Stage 61/62 junction. No formal service is verified at the exact junction.

facilities.name: No formal Kvarnsjön trail parking
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden notes no parking at the start, though a roadside pocket may be possible nearby. Do not treat this as a formal trailhead lot.

facilities.name: Grödinge kyrka bus 727 access
facilities.description: SL 727 access via Grödinge kyrka and the blue connector toward Kvarnsjön. Check live departures before relying on it.

facilities.name: Grödinge road-walk caution
facilities.description: Road access from Grödinge can involve a narrow 70 km/h road without sidewalk. Prefer the blue-marked connector where possible.

facilities.name: Husby / Husby Hammare cultural area
facilities.description: Cultural-landscape/rest context near the route before the road crossing. Approximate pin; not a guaranteed service point.

facilities.name: Nynäshamnsvägen crossing caution
facilities.description: Use care at and near the larger road crossing. The Rosenhill detour uses narrow, traffic-heavy road margins.

facilities.name: Rosenhill cafe/kiosk detour
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent food and drink about 1 km south of the trail. Useful but not on the direct stage line.

facilities.name: Rosenhill bus access
facilities.description: Bus access near Rosenhill, reached by detour from the route. Check SL because service varies.

facilities.name: Horse pasture bypass
facilities.description: Signed bypass around a horse pasture after the road crossing toward Axån. Use the bypass if horses/livestock are present or you are uncomfortable; keep dogs short-leashed.

facilities.name: Axsjön / Axaren spring
facilities.description: Official natural source north of Axsjön. Treat/filter/boil; not a tested potable tap. June/July 2025 hiker reports said it was almost dry, dry, or overgrown, so carry enough water to finish without it.

facilities.name: Axsjön spring dry caveat
facilities.description: Recent 2025 hiker reports said the spring was almost dry, dry, or overgrown. Treat it as a bonus source only, not a plan-critical refill.

facilities.name: Norrga dead-spruce caution
facilities.description: Norrga reserve has bark-beetle dead-spruce warnings; standing dead spruce can fall suddenly and without warning. Avoid this section in wind and follow local closure signs.

facilities.name: Norrga reserve rules
facilities.description: Norrga reserve: do not damage rock/soil, living or dead trees, plants, mosses, lichens, fungi, insects, or wildlife, and do not remove dead wood. Keep to marked paths and pack out waste.

facilities.name: Norrgaviken / Getaren route choice
facilities.description: Route-choice fork after Nolinge: north/left is shorter/direct; south/right is the recommended scenic line via Norrgaviken, Jungfruberget, Getaren shelter, views, bird boardwalk, and more varied nature. Current OSM/Naturkartan primary geometry follows the southern option.

facilities.name: Stage 62 GPX fragment caveat
facilities.description: The official bundled full-network GPX splits Stage 62's branch choice and Stage 7 continuation into separate unnamed segments. Do not import it as one ordered Stage 62 route; use OSM/Naturkartan geometry plus explicit variants.

facilities.name: Getaren shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point by Getaren. Free, shared, first-come; shelter-map data lists about six sleeping places, with no guaranteed firewood or trash service.

facilities.name: Getaren fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace beside the Getaren shelter. Use only when fires are allowed, bring fuel if needed, avoid disposable grills, and do not remove wood in reserve/outdoor-area land.

facilities.name: Getaren natural water only
facilities.description: Lake water only at the shelter area; no potable tap was verified and shelter listings mark water quality unknown. Treat/filter and carry backup. Avoid soap, dishwater, toileting, or washing in Getaren/Norrgaån.

facilities.name: Getaren/Jungfruberget viewpoint area
facilities.description: Lake/viewpoint rest context near Getaren and Jungfruberget. Approximate marker, not a service guarantee.

facilities.name: Getaren bird-bay boardwalk/hide
facilities.description: Boardwalk/bird-hide area near the north end of Getaren. Expect wet footing and stay on constructed paths where signed.

facilities.name: Stage 62 endpoint caveat
facilities.description: Official text treats Svarvaretorp/Stage 7 as the Stage 62 goal and Lida as a 1 km continuation. OSM relation 5655292 continues toward Lida, so show Lida as continuation/access rather than core Stage 62.

facilities.name: Svarvaretorp Stage 62 / Stage 7 junction
facilities.description: Best current OSM/Naturkartan Stage 62 endpoint and connection to Stage 7 toward Lida. The official endpoint coordinate is not published; do not substitute Lida's service coordinate as the stage endpoint.

facilities.name: Svarvaretorp parking/access
facilities.description: Parking/access near the Stage 62 finish/Lida side; Sörmlandsleden says parking is about 100 m left of the stage end. Confirm local signs and avoid assuming overnight parking permission.

facilities.name: Stage 7 continuation toward Lida
facilities.description: Onward trail connection after Stage 62 toward Lida and Stage 7. Use this for Lida services, but do not count Lida as part of Stage 62 proper.

facilities.name: Lida friluftsgård services
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe, outdoor-center services, bathing area, and managed facilities after the stage via Stage 7. Verify opening hours before relying on food or indoor toilets.

facilities.name: Lida/Getaren bathing quality
facilities.description: Lidabadet/Getaren had 2026 bathing-season classification Utmärkt kvalitet from 2025 samples, but check live samples and algal-bloom status during warm periods.

facilities.name: Lida service water
facilities.description: Reliable service-water context at Lida friluftsgård when facilities are open/available, including taps near Lida Gym/Vandrarhemmet and tent-area service buildings. After-stage refill, not on Stage 62 proper.

facilities.name: Lida toilets
facilities.description: Toilets at Lida friluftsgård area, opening/access dependent; Lida lists several seasonal/time-limited toilet clusters. After-stage facility via Stage 7.

facilities.name: Lida bus 721
facilities.description: Bus access at Lida after continuing beyond Stage 62. Last departures can be early; check SL live before using as a finish plan.

facilities.name: Lida parking
facilities.description: Large Lida outdoor-center parking after the stage via Stage 7. Lida says parking is only in signed areas and not at the bus stop or inside the area; follow current signs and overnight rules.

facilities.name: Lida tent meadow
facilities.description: Managed tenting option at/near Lida when permitted/booked, with hygiene hut/toilet/tap context. Use Lida's current rules rather than assuming allemansrätten camping in developed outdoor-center areas; longer reserve camping can require permission.

facilities.name: Lida local trail limitations
facilities.description: Some local Lida trails have ongoing access limitations, and Äventyrsstigen is closed until further notice because it crosses private business/agricultural land. Do not use it as a reroute.

facilities.name: Lida grill shelter rules
facilities.description: Lida grill/fireplace context after the stage. Use prepared places, bring permitted fuel when required, obey current fire bans, and avoid disposable grills where prohibited.
